title: Senior Java Developer - Central Government
description:
About The Role

Role: Senior Java Developer x 6 REF 103416
Contract Length: 12 months
Location: Hybrid/Manchester, Birmingham, Newcastle or Leeds -3 days per week in office
IR35: Inside
Pay Rate to Intermediary: £650 per day
Security Clearance: BPSS but candidates must be eligible for SC Clearance

Spinwell is recruiting for a Senior Java Developer for an excellent opportunity within the public sector.

RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE SENIOR JAVA DEVELOPER

The client is looking for an outstanding Java Developer, who can make a positive impact, and wants to contribute to the most demanding and exciting new digital service for the UK Government. Let's be clear about the impact of your work - better digital services in government will change the face of public services and have the potential to dramatically and positively transform the future of millions of people.

They are looking for the kind of person who is unconcerned with titles and hierarchy; what really excites the successful candidate is problem‑solving and the opportunity to deliver innovative technology that carries real value for users. The candidate will be expected to draw value from collaboration with others, actively seek input from colleagues and value a multidisciplinary team over hierarchy.

Day-to-day they will be an integral part of that team in designing, creating and improving new and existing products, platforms and transactions across government.

SKILLS/EXPERIENCE OF THE SENIOR JAVA DEVELOPER

  • Recent experience with Java 21 (or later).
  • Excellent understanding of TDD and BDD.
  • Experience with large microservice architectures.
  • Experience of working in an Agile environment.
  • Be willing to work in a pair programming environment.
  • Have experience in implementing APIs for internal and external use.
  • Have the skills to build up a useful, robust automated test suite to support a continuous deployment environment.
  • Be involved in the wider web development community, identifying good practices they can adopt and sharing experiences.
  • Be knowledgeable of tools and techniques used within the wider team.
  • Take part in 2nd-line support of applications and platforms, including occasional support outside of office hours.
  • Have an ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Have working knowledge of Unix-like operating systems such as Linux and/or Mac OS X.
  • Have the ability to quickly research and learn new programming tools and techniques.
  • Understand of the use of Responsive Web Design.

It would also be desirable to have:

  • Working knowledge of Jackson, JAX-RS, mocking frameworks such as Mockito, and messaging platforms such as ActiveMQ or Kafka.
  • Experience of MongoDB or other document databases.
  • Experience of building and scaling high‑traffic websites.
  • Experience of handling large data sets and scaling their handling and storage.

We welcome all applications regardless of background, in line with our commitment to diversity, equality and inclusion.

title: Software Engineer, Data Model
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We’re looking for an outstanding Software Engineer to join our Game Engine Data Model team. As a member of this team, you will innovate on the core data structures that form the backbone of Roblox’s platform. In this role you will have first hand opportunity to design and build one of the core technologies that makes the Roblox game engine special.

The Data Model is the object hierarchy that is analogous to a scene graph or entity system, powering all our experiences by exposing an interface between core engine capabilities and our creators. It also acts as a fabric to core technologies, such as networking, scripting, Studio, rendering and physics which are essential to the high performance of the Roblox game engine.

You Will:

  • Develop engine code that performs well for user-created games on the Roblox platform.
  • Work cross-functionally with other teams to deliver high-quality functionality.
  • Improve product quality by writing automated tests for your code.
  • Take ownership of features and projects, from design through launch.
  • Build and test code that runs across supported devices, including desktop, mobile, and console.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience, with hands-on experience developing in C++.
  • Knowledge: You are proficient in one or more programming languages (C++, C#, Go, Python or similar programming language). Familiarity with game engines, real-time systems, large-scale simulations or entity component systems is a plus
  • Curiosity: Strong willingness to learn, take on unfamiliar problems, and stay current with evolving technologies.
  • Strong Teamwork: You are able to collaborate in cross-functional and cross team projects to deliver the most curated technical solution.
  • Long-term Mindset: You are willing to take the long view to drive the collaboration and build the system.

Please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future F-1 or H-1B sponsorship at this time.

All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

$168,680—$212,490 USD

title: Warranty Clerk
description:
Warranty Clerk

Join the Hunter Chevrolet Team

Hunter Chevrolet is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Warranty Clerk to join our team. This position is ideal for someone who already understands warranty administration and can confidently manage claims, documentation, and manufacturer requirements.

The Warranty Clerk will be responsible for managing warranty claims from preparation and submission through reconciliation and payment while maintaining accurate records and supporting the service department.

What You'll Do

Warranty Claims & Administration

  • Prepare, review, and submit warranty claims accurately and within required deadlines.
  • Verify repair orders and supporting documentation before submitting claims.
  • Ensure claims meet manufacturer requirements and warranty guidelines.
  • Monitor submitted claims and follow up on rejected, pending, or unpaid claims.
  • Reconcile warranty payments and identify discrepancies.
  • Maintain complete and accurate warranty records.
  • Scan, organize, and maintain supporting warranty documentation.
  • Stay up to date on manufacturer warranty policies and procedures.

Department Support

  • Communicate with Service Advisors, Technicians, and management regarding warranty claims and missing information.
  • Assist with resolving claim issues and documentation discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate records of warranty transactions and payments.
  • Assist with related administrative and accounting duties as needed.
  • Protect confidential customer and company information.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous automotive warranty administration experience is required.
  • Strong understanding of automotive warranty claims and manufacturer requirements.
  • Experience reviewing repair orders and supporting documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Comfortable working with computers, dealership systems, and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple claims and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to work independently while also supporting a team.
  • Professional, dependable, and committed to providing quality work.

What We Offer

  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Wellness Program
  • Employee Discounts
  • Career Growth Opportunities
  • Supportive Leadership Team
  • Positive, Team-Oriented Work Environment
  • Employee Events & Celebrations

Why Hunter Chevrolet?

Hunter Chevrolet is part of Hunter Automotive Group, a fourth-generation, family-owned company that has proudly served Western North Carolina since 1940.

We believe in developing our employees, supporting professional growth, and creating opportunities for people to build long-term careers with our organization.

Our Core Focus is to improve the quality of life for our employees, customers, and community.

Our Core Values

  • Honesty
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Positive Attitude

If you have automotive warranty experience and are ready to bring your knowledge and attention to detail to a strong service team, apply today to join Hunter Chevrolet!

Hunter Chevrolet and Hunter Automotive Group are Equal Opportunity Employers.

title: Developer (Full-stack, Next.js/TypeScript)
description:
About DGXprt

DGXprt is an AI-enabled Dangerous Goods compliance platform, built to help organisations safely manage chemical storage, handling, and regulatory obligations in one of the most complex and highly regulated environments.

We launched in October 2025 and are already onboarding customers across Australia, with strong market validation and an external investor backing our vision.

We’re not building “another SaaS tool” — we’re building the next generation of compliance software: AI-driven, practitioner-informed, and designed to turn regulatory complexity into clear, confident action for businesses.

The opportunity

This is a rare chance to join DGXprt at an early stage and play a defining role in shaping both our product and engineering foundations.

You’ll work directly with the founders, influence core technical decisions, and help build a platform where AI, compliance logic, and modern software architecture come together in a genuinely meaningful way.

This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, rapid learning, and the satisfaction of building something right-first-time in a domain where quality, trust, and precision truly matter — while still moving at startup speed and with modern tools.

Next.js (App Router) with TypeScript, Next.js API routes and server actions, PostgreSQL via Supabase (including Row-Level Security), Supabase Auth, Vercel hosting, OpenAI APIs (server-side, controlled), and GitHub + Vercel CI/CD, within a security-first, multi-tenant SaaS approach.

What you’ll do

  • Build and improve frontend features using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Implement backend logic via API routes and server actions
  • Work with PostgreSQL data models, including multi-tenant patterns
  • Help integrate AI-assisted features, with validation and guardrails
  • Write clean, readable, well-tested code, contribute to reviews and design discussions
  • Build secure, compliant SaaS systems with least privilege and auditable design principles

What we’re looking for

Required

  • Around 1–3 years professional software development experience
  • Experience with React and/or Next.js
  • Working understanding of REST APIs and databases
  • Comfortable with Git, branching, and pull requests
  • Curious, proactive, and willing to ask questions and learn

Nice to have

  • PostgreSQL and/or Supabase experience
  • Exposure to SaaS or multi-tenant architectures
  • Interest in security, compliance, or regulated domains
  • Familiarity with cloud/serverless platforms

Location and eligibility

This role is remote, with the founding team based in Perth and Melbourne. Our preference is for candidates located in Perth or Melbourne to support occasional in-person collaboration, however we are open to other locations across Australia for the right candidate. Applicants must be Australian residents and have the right to work in Australia.

  • First engineering hire, direct access to founders, real product influence
  • Modern stack, pragmatic engineering, and a security and compliance mindset
  • A genuinely new market space, applying AI carefully in a regulated domain
  • High trust, high ownership, and strong learning curve

How to apply

Send a CV and a short note on why this role interests you to .

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Staff Software Engineer (Thomas)

Thomasnet, part of Xometry, is the industrial platform where millions of buyers find and source from North American manufacturers and suppliers.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join Thomas engineering. As a senior individual contributor, you will guide software implementation across several engineering teams and influence decisions across our technology organization. Thomas is moving from a traditional supplier directory to AI-assisted sourcing, and you will set technical direction for the shared systems and AI infrastructure that this shift depends on, while staying hands-on in the code.

How You'll Contribute

  • Hands-on technical leadership. Write and review architectural plans for new projects, then participate in implementation with the teams.
  • Guide innovation. Champion a good mix of proven and cutting-edge technologies and methods. Know when to change course and when to double down on what already works, including how we adopt AI across the platform.
  • Teaching and mentorship. Serve as a mentor and guide to engineers across the organization, helping them grow their skills.
  • Code review. Do code review and mentor others across the org to perform good code reviews.
  • Operational excellence. Deliver reliable, high-quality software that exceeds customer expectations and aligns with business timelines.
  • Collaborative strategy. Build strong partnerships with product managers, designers, and leadership to promote open communication, strong collaboration, and high standards.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with a track record of owning outcomes, setting technical direction across teams, mentoring engineers at all levels, and influencing product and business decisions.
  • Strong full-stack engineering skills that are transferrable to our stack: backend services in TypeScript and Node.js with GraphQL APIs, a React and Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL and analytical data stores, and search such as OpenSearch, at production scale. Comparable experience in another modern stack counts just as much; prior experience with our exact tools is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with the engineering behind AI products: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, or embedding models. We hire AI-native engineers who build with these tools and judge their output rigorously, whatever the specific frameworks.
  • Depth in areas our platform is growing into, such as multimodal (image and text) embeddings and search, agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain), model fine-tuning and adaptation, with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • A fast learner with high agency who works fluently in an AI-native development environment and shares what they learn. We are all still learning how to build with AI, and we want people who help the team learn faster.
  • Marketplace or multi-sided platform experience is highly desirable, with an understanding of scaling shared platforms.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration, comfortable engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, from junior ICs to executives.

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match; medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP and other wellbeing resources; and much more.

title: Program Manager
description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Program Manager to join our rapidly growing and innovative cybersecurity team!

As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day oversight of contractor personnel and Task Order performance including technical delivery and P&L. You will be responsible for the hands-on technical management of Valiant Cybersecurity and other Information Technology Federal engagements, supporting the evolution of the Government customer's IT posture. You will take an active role in Valiant’s Knowledge Centers and grow professional expertise in emerging Cybersecurity tools and techniques. You will lead your team to ensure the accomplishments of the program are documented and known for more broad company efforts through whitepapers, briefing materials, and proposals. As Program Manager, you should be able to execute with limited direction, anticipate customer needs and proactively supports those needs, and be responsible for all project deliverables. The candidate will have had prior experience working with a wide variety of technologies, be well versed in the current state of Information Security, and be able to interpret the requirements of relevant governing bodies (NIST, OMB, GAO, etc). The candidate will be required to interface with federal employees and contractors to perform the required activities. The ideal candidate will have prior experience performing similar work for a federal client, including strategic planning, solution development, and FISMA assessments.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: SW Washington, DC ( 3 days onsite / 2 days telework)

This position allows for partial remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Experience:

  • 10+ years of Program Management experience with federal government agencies
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, related degree or an additional three (3) years of relevant experience.
  • PMP required
  • 5+ years of knowledge and practical understanding of Governance, Risk, and Compliance
  • Experience managing personnel in multiple locations across the United States
  • Experience interfacing with senior levels of customer organizations
  • Demonstrated experience leading and managing projects with the ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work towards a strict deadline
  • Strong background and understanding of cybersecurity principles, industry security requirements, and best practices
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work towards strict deadlines
  • Domain expertise and implementation experience providing best practices and recommendations to support the resolution of project challenges, both business and technical
  • Ability to lead in an Agile framework (conduct backlog grooming with the client; create tasks and clearly document the “Definition of Done”, assign in daily scrum, conduct retrospectives).
  • Proven experience leading and executing executive presentations, demonstrations, and reporting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure projects and enhancements meet all requirements to ensure the projects are completed within schedule, cost, and performance
  • Monitor each project by providing timely project assessment, per the Contract Service
  • Participate in routine and periodic status meetings with key customer personnel, at times on short notice, to convey the current status and risks are presented
  • Provide Project management support following industry standards, frameworks, and methodologies to perform a variety of project management functions such as; project management plans, work breakdown structure/schedules, risk mitigation plans, and project timelines.
  • Ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs), of projects progress, risks, issues, and proposed resolutions
  • Perform operations management and project management for a variety of information technology deliverables and task orders.
  • Strategic planning and solution development, both technical and business
  • Ensure project-defined deliverables are provided on time, and have been quality reviewed (e.g. SOPs, Configuration Guides, Training Documentation, Project Schedules)
  • Establish project schedules and plans with Government Stakeholders
  • Track and provide performance management evaluations against Project Plans
  • Ensure delivery on Program and Project deliverables (e.g. Weekly Team and Project Status Reporting, Bi-Weekly Program Reporting, Timesheet Review, Performance Management Metric Analysis)
  • Provide presentations and develop demonstrations for reporting in support of the program
  • Provide technical support for all team task areas (e.g. systems engineering and integration, service design and delivery)
  • Facilitate requirements and data gathering
  • Develop and Refine Performance Management Metrics in accordance with Program Goals and Deliverable requirements sessions

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions is a security-focused IT solutions provider with public clients nationwide. Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. As a company, we are just as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class IT solutions, all while enjoying an unparalleled work-life balance. We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. title: Field Operations Supervisor - Mobile Patrol
description:
Pay: $26.50/hourly
Location: Wilmington, MA
Employment Type: Full-Time
Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday, 11:00 PM–7:00 AM — 40 hours/week

Securitas is hiring a Field Operations Supervisor to oversee overnight Mobile Patrol operations across multiple client locations. This is a hands-on field leadership position for someone who can coordinate officers across active patrol routes, respond to changing priorities, and make sure scheduled security tours are completed accurately and on time.

The Field Operations Supervisor maintains visibility over Mobile Patrol activity throughout the shift, supports officers in the field, responds to incidents and coverage issues, and helps ensure consistent service across assigned client locations.

What You'll Do

  • Supervise Mobile Patrol Officers conducting security tours and site inspections across multiple client locations
  • Monitor officer locations and tour progress throughout the shift
  • Coordinate route order and timing to ensure required patrols are completed within scheduled windows
  • Re-route or reassign officers when call-outs, urgent requests, or site issues affect coverage
  • Respond to alarms, access issues, suspicious activity, property damage, and other incidents identified during patrols
  • Coordinate with local law enforcement when incidents require a joint response
  • Maintain regular communication with officers for check-ins, direction, and safety accountability
  • Review digital tour and incident reports for accuracy and completeness
  • Follow up on missed, late, or incomplete patrols and address recurring issues
  • Monitor patrol vehicle condition, mileage, and safe operation
  • Escalate significant incidents and operational concerns to branch or client leadership as appropriate

Systems & Mobile Patrol Administration

This position also supports the systems that keep Mobile Patrol operations running effectively. Responsibilities may include:

  • Using TrackTik to monitor checkpoint tours, live GPS activity, incidents, and reporting
  • Assisting with the setup and maintenance of site patrol tours
  • Programming and replacing NFC checkpoint tags, barcodes, and QR checkpoints
  • Configuring tour timing, checkpoint requirements, exception questions, and photo requirements
  • Troubleshooting damaged or missing checkpoint equipment

What We're Looking For

  • Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and make adjustments throughout an active overnight shift
  • Comfortable supervising employees who are working independently across multiple locations
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Ability to review reports and identify missed or incomplete work
  • Comfortable using GPS, mobile technology, and electronic security reporting systems
  • Ability to respond calmly and appropriately to incidents and changing operational needs
  • Experience with TrackTik or similar security management software is preferred
  • Previous security, field supervision, mobile patrol, or operations experience is preferred

This role requires someone who can balance field supervision, problem-solving, accountability, and client service while keeping a geographically dispersed Mobile Patrol operation on track.

Occasional availability by phone or text outside scheduled shift hours may be required for urgent operational matters.

If you're an experienced security professional or operations leader who enjoys working in the field, supporting officers, and solving problems in real time, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Program Manager - Data Operations
description:
About Us
Butlr is on a mission to make the built environment people-aware. We live and work in houses and buildings that aren't aware of their inhabitants. We heat and cool spaces when no one is in them, clean areas that haven't been used, and lease office space that no one is using. Our vision is to enable smarter buildings and increase the quality of life while respecting privacy.


Spun out of the MIT Media Lab in 2019 with offices in Silicon Valley and Boston, Butlr was founded by Forbes 30 Under 30 entrepreneurs Honghao Deng and Jiani Zeng. Butlr pioneers in space occupancy and people sensing technologies and delivers rich spatial intelligence for workplace, retail, and healthcare use cases. We help customers revolutionize the way they operate in human-centric environments, ensuring efficiency and productivity at every step.

We are backed by top venture capital institutions and strategic investors such as Foundry Group, Tiger Global, Qualcomm Ventures, E14 Fund, and Carrier, among others. We are recognized as one of Fast Company's "2024 Most Innovative Companies", Inc. Magazine's "2023 Best in Business'' (AI & Data Category), World Economic Forum's Top Innovator in YES San Francisco Challenge, among other awards/recognitions. We operate with top occupiers, landlords, care facilities, and service providers in North America, Europe, and Asia. We pride ourselves in providing exceptional solutions and service to numerous prestigious customers, tech giants, and world's largest conglomerates and brands.

We are hiring talented and passionate people to join our team to help us continue our rapid growth.

The Role
You'll own our data center projects end to end. You'll connect Butlr with partner and customer teams, build the plan, and drive every workstream until the system is live and the customer is ready to expand. After launch, you'll stay on as the customer's technical success lead. This is a hands-on role for someone who gets things done and follows up until they are done.

What You'll Do

  • Kick off fast: Bring Butlr, partner, and customer teams together quickly. Set roles, timelines, and how teams communicate from day one.
  • Build and run the plan: Turn deal commitments into a detailed project plan with milestones, dependencies, and owners. Track the plan every week, raise risks early, and push to resolve blockers.
  • Oversee pilots and internal testing: Own pilot and validation testing in live data center environments, partnering with engineering to plan tests, deploy and monitor equipment, and translate results into product and deployment decisions.
  • Drive technical integration: Coordinate engineering teams on both sides so integrations and data flows go live on schedule.
  • Own pre-launch readiness: Work with Product to confirm that features, configurations, documentation, and support are ready before go-live.
  • Manage hardware logistics: Work with Supply Chain and Logistics to make sure POC units are configured, fully tested, quality-checked, and shipped on time.
  • Handle every detail: Site access, installation schedules, customer requirements, and status reporting for internal leaders and external stakeholders.
  • Own the customer after launch: Serve as the technical customer success lead. Monitor system health and customer adoption, run regular check-ins, and resolve issues quickly.
  • Grow the account: Turn successful POCs into long-term contracts. Spot expansion and upsell opportunities and bring them to Sales.
  • Make it repeatable: Capture lessons learned and build a playbook so each new POC runs faster than the last.
  • Coordinate across sites and borders: Drive deployments across US and international sites, partner with our Shenzhen team, and manage customs and import logistics so equipment arrives on time.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management, solutions delivery, or technical customer success.
  • Experience across the data center ecosystem, including critical infrastructure (power, cooling, racks), GPU/AI server platforms, and related equipment and services.
  • A track record of delivering hardware and software deployments across multiple teams, with external partners and customers involved.
  • Enough technical depth to coordinate engineers on integrations, APIs, and data flows. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand it.
  • A strong sense of ownership. You hold people accountable, including people who don't report to you, and you're comfortable pushing to get things done.
  • Clear, organized communication with engineers and executives alike.
  • Ability to travel at least 30% of the time, including internationally, to customer sites, partner facilities, and data center deployments.
  • Fluent in Mandarin Chinese, and/or experience working with partners in Taiwan or China.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with IoT, sensors, digital twins, or building and facility technology.
  • Experience in a startup or another fast-moving environment.

Why working at Butlr is great!

We are building a culture that puts people first! We’re a team of engaging, motivated, and intelligent problem-solvers who are committed to making an impact. We believe in fostering a culture of healthy work-life balance, and we encourage an inviting, collaborative, fun work environment.

Benefits

  • World-class team with low ego
  • A work environment that is flexible
  • Comprehensive health benefits package
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Flexible time off
  • Professional development opportunities

title: Senior BI Analyst
description:
About the Role:

Talent Insights is partnering with a well-known brand as they uplift their analytics function and push the business towards self-serve reporting.

This isn't a pure dashboard-building role, and it isn't a pure data engineering role - it's both. We're looking for someone who can sit down with a stakeholder, translate what they actually need into a technical solution, build the underlying data model in Databricks and SQL, validate that the data is fit for purpose, and then bring it to life in Power BI.

One person owning data through to story, rather than a hand-off between a data person and a viz person.

You'll be joining a team mid-migration from Tableau to Power BI, so experience with both platforms is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Partner directly with stakeholders to gather requirements and shape them into a data and visualisation solution
  • Build and maintain data models and semantic layers in Databricks, using SQL (Python a plus)
  • Validate and quality-check data to confirm it's fit for purpose before it reaches a dashboard
  • Design and build semantic models that support the business's shift towards self-serve reporting
  • Build Power BI dashboards and reports that clearly and effectively tell the story behind the data
  • Support the ongoing migration of existing Tableau dashboards into Power BI
  • Work autonomously, taking ownership of problems end-to-end rather than waiting for direction
Skills & Experience
  • Must have: hands-on Databricks and SQL experience
  • Must have: deep, demonstrable Power BI development experience
  • Must have: solid working knowledge of Tableau (migration experience highly regarded)
  • Strong data modelling and semantic model design skills, ideally with self-serve reporting in mind
  • Python experience nice to have, not essential
  • Experience in telco is a bonus, but skillset matters more than industry background
  • Self-driven with strong stakeholder management - comfortable running requirements conversations and owning the outcome
  • A genuine passion for turning data into a clear, compelling story - not just building charts, but understanding what they need to show
  • Prior experience blending data engineering/modelling work with visualisation delivery (rather than working purely on one side of that line)

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

We are actively hiring for an Surgical Tech Certified First Assistant.

The Surgical First Assistant possesses and demonstrates competencies related to the preoperative and intraoperative aspects of care. Serves as first assistant in designated surgical procedures under the direct supervision of the operating surgeon / physician; handles all variety of tissue appropriately to reduce potential for injury or compromised blood supply; uses surgical instruments appropriately, employs principles of safe tissue handling; provides exposure to operative site; provides and maintains hemostasis and performs wound closure; demonstrates advanced knowledge of normal and pathological anatomy and physiology.

  • Safely positions patients for the surgical procedure and assists with transport to and from the operative suite
  • Assists surgeon in identifying patient and staff safety hazards
  • Surgical prepping and draping of patients for the surgical procedure
  • Provides exposure of the operative site by the appropriate use of retractors
  • Manipulates equipment and instruments to enhance the visual field
  • Suctions and sponges to maintain a dry surgical field resulting in an optimal visualization of the surgical field
  • Provides counter-traction of tissue utilizing various instruments
  • Assists with maintaining hemostasis to reduce potential for fluid volume deficits by clamping / ligating vessels, using electrocautery to tissue, applying manual direct pressure, assisting with use of pharmaceutical agents (e.g. topical thrombin) and other means as directed by the surgeon / physician
  • Ties and cuts sutures
  • Skillfully sutures all varieties of tissues / tissue planes with appropriate suture materials and suturing techniques. Assists in closure of wound or independently closes wound under the direction of the surgeon.
  • Assists and independently applies dressing and tape at the end of the surgical procedure using proper aseptic / sterile techniques
  • Maintains current knowledge of procedures performed

Qualifications

  • Graduate of an Accredited Surgical Assistant Program
  • Graduate from Surgical Tech Program
  • Certification as a CSA, SA-C, or CST/CFA through their respective certifying bodies
  • Must be licensed to practice as a Surgical Assistant in Illinois
  • CPR Certification required
  • Must have one (1) year of Surgical Tech experience.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Full Stack AI Solutions
description:
VistaVu Solutions is an employee-owned tech company on a high growth curve. We deliver full lifecycle ERP implementations, transformation projects, and responsive support through our partnerships with SAP S/4Hana Cloud, SAP Business One, SAP Business ByDesign, Boomi, and Amazon Web Services to mid-market companies in a broad range of industries primarily within the United States and Canada. In addition, we provide customer specific solutions to our customers that enable the customer to be unique, meet their unique requirements and allow them to innovate at speed Our industry-specific expertise, product extensions, and award-winning services help our customers RUN GREAT!


It’s our people that make VistaVu unique and different from other technology solution providers. We are intelligent, caring, driven and committed to the vision. We advocate for our customers and earn their trust by understanding their business, using proven processes to serve their needs, and delivering a high return on investment. Our core values shape our culture, define our character, and guide how to make decisions across every level of our organization.


Build AI solutions where the work happens

As a Forward Deployed Engineer — AI Solutions at VistaVu Solutions, you will work alongside customers to understand their business problems, learn how their teams operate, and build AI solutions that become part of everyday work. You will stay close to the people using what you build, connecting business discovery with hands-on software development and practical delivery.


This is a customer-embedded engineering role, not primarily an advisory or pre-sales position. You will write production code, integrate AI with enterprise systems, and help customers move from an initial idea to a solution they can trust and use. This is a hybrid role based in Calgary, Alberta. Remote candidates based elsewhere in Canada may also be considered.


What you will do

  • Embed with customer teams to observe their work, understand business problems and workflow constraints, and identify where AI can make a practical difference. Translate those insights into clear use cases and shared acceptance criteria.
  • Design and build working AI applications, assistants, and agent-based workflows. Write and test code, choose appropriate models and retrieval approaches, and validate solution behaviour with real customer scenarios rather than stopping at a demonstration.
  • Connect AI solutions to enterprise APIs, data sources, and business workflows, with appropriate authentication, permissions, and data quality controls. Apply single sign-on and role-based access so people and AI agents can access only the data they should, protecting customer data in line with enterprise security and compliance standards.
  • Take promising prototypes into production with maintainable code, automated tests, evaluation, deployment practices, and monitoring. Address failure modes, latency, cost, and supportability. Own solutions on AWS from discovery and design through automated deployment, monitoring and alerts, usage and cost analytics, fast issue resolution, and customer support in production. Use automated app-code tests and AI accuracy tests and evals to establish reliability.
  • Test solutions with users, improve usability, and support adoption. Provide practical documentation and enablement so customer teams can operate the solution and understand when human review is needed.
  • Collaborate with client business stakeholders, IT teams, and data owners, alongside VistaVu’s architecture, engineering, and delivery colleagues. Explain technical trade-offs and keep decisions tied to the customer’s problem.
  • Improve reliability through troubleshooting, user feedback, and evaluation. Build safeguards for sensitive data, model errors, and actions that require approval.
  • Turn customer learning into reusable components, integration patterns, evaluation methods, and delivery approaches, while protecting customer-specific data and requirements.
  • Review other developers’ work and help them grow their Claude and full-stack skills.


What you bring

  • Experience building and supporting production software, with strong full-stack coding skills in TypeScript, Angular, and Node.js, plus Python for backend and AI work, including maintainable application design, version control, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Practical experience with large language models, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, or agent workflows. Ability to evaluate outputs, manage context, and recognize when a non-AI approach is more appropriate. Experience building production applications, workflows, and AI agents on the Claude API, including tool use, agent design, prompt engineering, and evals.
  • Ability to integrate applications through REST and other APIs and work with structured and unstructured data, including databases, authentication, access controls, and data quality.
  • Strong business discovery skills: uncovering the problem behind a request, mapping workflows, and translating ambiguous needs into deliverable engineering scope.
  • Clear customer communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including thoughtful questions, understandable trade-offs, progress demonstrations, and constructive responses to feedback.
  • Ownership across delivery and operation, with sound judgement about security, reliability, and human oversight. Comfort working closely with users while remaining accountable for implementation quality.
  • Experience building serverless applications on AWS using Lambda, DynamoDB for documents, and Aurora DSQL for relational data.
  • SAP and ERP integration experience is an asset, including OData and SOAP APIs, SAP-specific data and integration challenges, and the end-to-end processes behind them: sales through delivery and billing, and purchasing through supplier invoicing.
  • Experience with additional cloud platforms or managed AI services beyond the required AWS stack is preferred.
  • Knowledge of operational processes such as finance, supply chain, inventory, manufacturing, or customer service.



Why Join VistaVu Solutions?

  • Influence the direction of our rapidly growing mid-market business.
  • Competitive remuneration
  • Work with great people in an environment where we live our core values.
  • Growth as we provide you challenges and opportunities to advance your career development and training.


At VistaVu Solutions, we are committed to an inclusive and equitable workforce that values, represents and supports the communities in which we work and live. We welcome people from all backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences and are committed to maintaining a respectful work environment that also supports the diverse needs of our employees. We encourage applications from all individuals including those who are Indigenous, members of visible minority groups, of varied abilities, persons of any sexual orientation or gender identity and expression, as well as with any other dimension of diversity.

title: Senior Engineer, PD Adv NAND Dry Etch
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

As a Staff/Senior engineer, you will be a part of revolutionary next generation NAND research & development dry etch team driving critical modules listed below. You will work directly with process integration and other process areas such as Wet etch, CVD, Diffusion, Metals, Lithography & CMP. Internships could be considered as a part of job experience.

  • Background in construction management and/or other fall hazard-related industry
  • Work experience or certification in occupational health & safety preferred
  • Strong interest educating people on the importance and value of health & safety training
  • Self-starter who is able to work independently, while also contributing to a team
  • Strong presentation and adult-engagement skills
  • Valid Ontario’s Driver Licence - occasional travel by car for work

Why A Career At Worksite Is For You

title: Board Trustee
company: Mental Health Foundation of New Zealand
description:
In 2027 the Mental Health Foundation of New Zealand will celebrate 50 years as a beacon of wellbeing, advocacy, and community strength. Strong governance is vital to enduring impact, and we are seeking leaders who bring courage, clarity, and compassion to the table. If you are ready to serve, to listen, and to lead, your voice and vision are needed now to ensure that mental health awareness and support remains at the heart of Aotearoa’s communities.



The MHF is a charitable trust committed to lifting the mental health and wellbeing of all people in Aotearoa New Zealand. We do this by:



  • Advocating for a better mental health system and society.
  • Promoting everyday actions people can take to lift mental wellbeing.
  • Providing tools that support people through tough times.



Over the past year, over 1,000,000 people have put some form of regular wellbeing action into their lives as a result of our work and our tools, tips and programmes that support people and communities through tough times reached over 600,000 people.

The MHF also maintains a consistent and influential presence, offering trusted advice and advocacy to politicians and government decision-makers. In times of shifting social conditions, it stands as a vital voice for improving mental health services and shaping policies that support the wellbeing of all New Zealanders.



In all our work MHF are informed by lived experience through our staff and board, our advisory groups, sector relationships and consultation processes.



Mauri tū, Mauri ora - Creating space for and unleashing the positive life force found in all things.



As a member of the Mental Health Foundation’s board you will:

  • Bring a proven commitment to promote mental health and wellbeing
  • Contribute, at a governance level, to the development, implementation and review of the Foundation’s strategic plan and annual work programme and the support and oversight of the Chief Executive.
  • Contribute to the board’s performance review and development.


We are particularly seeking applicants with:

  • A professional accounting qualification (Chartered Accountant, CA ANZ, or equivalent), at senior manager level or above in practice, or in an equivalent role such as financial controller, finance director or CFO in industry, the public sector or the not-for-profit sector.
  • A strong working knowledge of financial processes, controls and reporting, and the ability to read, interpret and challenge financial statements, budgets and forecasts.
  • Experience overseeing risk management frameworks and internal controls, and working with external auditors on the annual audit.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain financial and risk matters clearly to trustees and to work constructively with management.
  • Proven governance experience, or a clear readiness to step into a governance role, demonstrated through regular work with boards and senior stakeholders, and an understanding of the difference between governance and management.
  • The ability and interest to Chair the Foundation’s Board Finance, Risk & Audit Committee


Applicants with Te Ao Māori expertise or with strong understanding of Pasifika, Asian and migrant communities are encouraged to apply.


At the MHF we often are confronted with difficult stories about mental health, distress and suicide. Please consider your own mental health and ability to be exposed to this information prior to applying. Rainbow and takatāpui candidates are welcome and encouraged to apply. The Mental Health Foundation actively promotes the articles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi.


Commitment required

  • Preparation for and attendance and participation at board meetings (which are approximately quarterly), and membership (and Chair) of the Board’s Finance, Risk and Audit Committee (also approximately quarterly).
  • Board meetings are usually held at the MHF offices in Auckland. Members sometimes participate online. Committee meetings are usually held online.
  • Being familiar with and meeting the requirements of the Foundation’s trust deed and governance handbook.


Term

Three years. The Board may reappoint Trustees for a further two terms.


Application

  • A short letter summarising the skills and experience you bring to the MHF board and the reasons for your interest in contributing to our work.
  • A resume detailing your work history and relevant experience and qualifications.

title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Browser (New Products)
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role

Mozilla is seeking experienced browser engineers to join a small team exploring new applications of browser technology. The work combines deep systems engineering, rapid experimentation, and close collaboration across technical disciplines.

We are looking for a browser engine specialist who enjoys turning difficult systems questions into working experiments. You will investigate browser behavior, implement changes deep in the engine, and establish which ideas produce meaningful improvements. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of engine-level investigations and implementation, working closely with the team’s technical lead.

The work suits someone who has built or substantially changed browser internals, understands the tradeoffs embedded in those systems, and enjoys applying that knowledge to unfamiliar problems. Your experiments will help inform technical direction.

What you'll do:

Design and implement experiments within browser engine subsystems. Investigate how internal data structures and execution behavior affect performance, correctness, and the interfaces exposed to developer tools.

Evaluate ways to represent and expose browser state efficiently and accurately. Identify the tradeoffs in each approach, including information loss, implementation complexity, and compatibility with dynamic web content.

Prototype engine capabilities that support reliable programmatic interaction with web content. Investigate how document structure, layout, navigation, and event handling affect correctness and performance.

Instrument browser behavior and evaluate changes against repeatable tasks. Measure performance and correctness, isolate the effect of each change, and document unsuccessful experiments as clearly as successful ones. Check that gains hold beyond the workloads used to develop the prototype.

Profile the overhead introduced by new capabilities and pursue improvements where measurements justify them. Use AI tools to accelerate coding and analysis, and verify their output through debugging, tests, and measurement.

What you'll bring:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in at least one browser engine subsystem, such as DOM and Web APIs, layout and rendering, accessibility, JavaScript runtimes, or networking and process architecture. You have implemented substantial changes and can trace their effects into neighboring subsystems.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ or Rust, experience navigating a large systems codebase, and practical knowledge of memory ownership, concurrency, object lifetimes, and performance debugging. You can build the JavaScript and scripting tools needed to exercise and measure your work.
  • A demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar code, form a precise hypothesis, construct a useful prototype, and interpret the results. You can separate the effects of your implementation from variability in websites, workloads, or model behavior.
  • A strong understanding of web platform behavior and compatibility. You can reason about how document structure, script execution, rendering, and user interaction relate, including cases where the browser’s internal state is difficult to expose accurately to another system.
  • Experience with profiling, tracing, regression tests, or conformance tests, and a habit of grounding performance claims in reproducible evidence. You can explain both the benefit of an optimization and the circumstances in which it fails.
  • Curiosity about AI agents and a willingness to work directly with agent harnesses and coding tools. You can connect a low-level implementation choice to the information an agent receives and the work it must do next.

Nice to have:

  • Contributions to Gecko, Servo, Blink, WebKit, or another browser engine
  • Experience maintaining an open-source project

title: DEXA Technologist (Contingent/Part Time)
description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The DEXA Technologist performs dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DEXA) scans to assess bone mineral density and body composition in accordance with established clinical protocols, radiation safety standards, and regulatory requirements. This position supports patient care, research activities, and preventive health initiatives by ensuring accurate image acquisition, data collection, and patient education.

The ideal candidate demonstrates excellent patient service skills, attention to detail, proficiency in imaging procedures, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced outpatient and/or research environment.

This is a contingent part-time, non-benefited position scheduled on an as-needed basis to support clinical care and research operations. Work schedules, hours, and shift lengths may vary based on operational and business needs and are not guaranteed. This position is onsite.



This position will fulfill the following specific functions:



Patient Care

  • Prepare patients for DEXA examinations by reviewing medical history, explaining procedures, and addressing patient questions or concerns.
  • Obtain and document patient height, weight, demographic information, and relevant clinical history.
  • Position patients appropriately to ensure accurate and reproducible scan results.
  • Perform bone density and body composition scans according to established protocols.
  • Monitor patients during procedures and respond appropriately to patient needs.



Imaging and Clinical Operations

  • Operate and maintain DEXA equipment in accordance with manufacturer guidelines and organizational policies.
  • Conduct daily quality control and calibration procedures.
  • Verify image quality and complete preliminary review for technical accuracy.
  • Ensure proper documentation and upload of scan results into the electronic medical record (EMR) and/or research database.
  • Maintain compliance with radiation safety requirements and infection prevention practices.



Research Support

  • Perform study-related DEXA assessments according to approved protocols.
  • Maintain accurate source documentation and data collection records.
  • Coordinate with research coordinators, investigators, and sponsors regarding scheduling and protocol requirements.
  • Ensure adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards and research procedures when applicable.
  • Comply with all applicable research regulations, institutional policies, study protocols, and participant confidentiality requirements.



Administrative Responsibilities

  • Schedule and confirm patient appointments as needed.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements at all times.
  • Assist with inventory management and ordering of necessary supplies.
  • Participate in staff meetings, audits, and quality improvement initiatives.



QUALIFICATIONS


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Training will be provided where necessary, and support may be provided to assist employees in performing assigned responsibilities. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.


  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Graduate of an accredited radiologic technology program or recognized bone densitometry training program, as applicable.
  • Current California licensure, certification, permits, and registrations required to legally perform assigned radiologic or bone densitometry duties in California.
  • Basic computer proficiency and experience working with EMR systems.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively manage assigned responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Certified Bone Densitometry Technologist (CBDT) credential through the International Society for Clinical Densitometry (ISCD) preferred.
  • ARRT certification in Radiography, Nuclear Medicine, or another imaging discipline preferred.
  • Previous experience performing DEXA scans in a clinical, imaging, or research setting preferred.
  • Experience working with research participants and study protocols preferred.
  • Familiarity with eClinicalWorks (EMR) preferred.
  • Experience operating a Lunar iDXA bone health and metabolic health assessment scanner is preferred; training will be provided.

LANGUAGE SKILLS



Proficient English language skills, including speaking, reading, writing, and comprehension, sufficient to communicate effectively with patients, research participants, healthcare providers, and staff, and to accurately complete required documentation. Intermediate Spanish language skills, including speaking, reading, and writing, are preferred.



PHYSICAL DEMANDS


The physical demands described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, talk, hear, and climb stairs. Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate imaging equipment, computers, medical devices, and office equipment, including the collection, documentation, and entry of patient and research data, is required. The employee must frequently reach with hands and arms.


The position requires close visual acuity to review imaging results, electronic records, study documentation, and other detailed information. Adequate hearing and verbal communication abilities are necessary to effectively interact with patients, research participants, healthcare providers, and study personnel.


The employee may be required to stand for extended periods while performing DEXA examinations and assisting with patient positioning. The employee may occasionally be required to lift, carry, push, pull, and/or move equipment, supplies, or materials weighing up to 25 pounds.


Regular and reliable attendance, including adherence to scheduled work hours, is an essential function of this position. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.


WORK ENVIRONMENT


Work is performed primarily in an outpatient clinical setting and may include clinical examination areas, imaging rooms, research facilities, and administrative workspaces. The position requires frequent interaction with patients, research participants, healthcare providers, and study staff. Employees may be required to move between clinical, research, and administrative areas to perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate, and the illumination of the work area is primarily fluorescent and other artificial lighting.


This position is associated with exposure to biohazardous materials and communicable diseases requiring adherence to universal precautions at all times, as well as other conditions commonly encountered in clinical and research environments.


Employees are required to follow all applicable safety procedures, infection prevention protocols, radiation safety requirements, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by organizational policy and applicable regulatory requirements.


The duties and responsibilities described above are not intended to be a comprehensive list. Management reserves the right to assign additional job-related duties and responsibilities consistent with business needs.

Skills

title: Experienced Corporate Security Officer - Manhattan, NY - $25.50/hr.
description:
CORPORATE SECURITY OFFICER

Manhattan, NY | $25.50/Hour | Full-Time

Experienced Corporate Security Professionals Wanted

Securitas is seeking an experienced, professional, and highly observant Corporate Security Officer to join a specialized security team supporting a corporate client in Manhattan, NY.

This is an opportunity for an experienced security professional who understands that corporate security is about more than simply monitoring a post. The ideal candidate is confident assessing situations, recognizing potential threats, maintaining discretion, communicating effectively, and responding appropriately when circumstances require immediate attention.

You will help protect people, property, facilities, and business operations while providing a professional experience to employees, visitors, executives, and VIPs.

POSITION DETAILS

Pay: $25.50 per hour
Location: Manhattan, NY
Schedule: Full-Time

Environment: Professional corporate setting with indoor and outdoor responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Corporate Security Officer, you will:

  • Monitor and control access to the client's facility using established security systems and procedures.
  • Proactively observe and identify suspicious, unusual, or concerning activity.
  • Conduct interior and exterior patrols and security checks.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to alarms, emergencies, security concerns, and unusual situations.
  • Investigate and appropriately escalate security incidents.
  • Prepare accurate daily activity reports, incident reports, and other required documentation.

  • Assist with reception and departure of VIPs in coordination with the Executive Protection security team.

  • Maintain consistent communication with the client and security team regarding special circumstances or concerns.
  • Work with law enforcement and emergency personnel when serious situations arise.
  • Provide professional customer service while maintaining security protocols and control.
  • Operate security equipment, radios, mobile devices, access control systems, and other technology used in daily operations.
  • Support special projects and additional security assignments as needed.
  • Perform occasional duties outside of regularly scheduled hours, including evenings and weekends.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Professional, discreet, and highly observant.
  • Confident maintaining security and control in a corporate environment.
  • Calm and composed when dealing with high-pressure or unexpected situations.
  • An excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing.
  • Able to make sound decisions quickly and appropriately.
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.
  • A strong team player who communicates effectively with colleagues and clients.
  • Flexible and dependable when operational needs change.
  • Committed to confidentiality and professional discretion.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a licensed Security Officer (must show experience on current resume)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience working in a corporate security environment.
  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.
  • Must possess a valid U.S. state-issued driver's license or non-driver identification.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid New York State Security Guard License.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and patrol for extended periods.
  • Ability to climb stairs and work across interior and exterior areas.
  • Ability to lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

The following experience is highly valued:

  • Security Operations Center (SOC) or command center experience.
  • Military or law enforcement background.
  • Access control and visitor management systems.
  • Alarm monitoring and response.
  • Badging operations.
  • Professional incident report writing.
  • Genetec or other CCTV/security video systems.
  • Microsoft Office, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Google Workspace.
  • PTT/radio communication systems.
  • First Aid, CPR, and AED certification.
  • Experience with workplace technology platforms such as Slack or Box.
  • Ability to use mobile devices and cameras for documentation.
  • Ability to quickly communicate and escalate information by phone or radio.

PHYSICAL & WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Patrol interior and exterior areas.
  • Climb stairs.
  • Work outdoors in varying weather conditions when required.
  • Maintain visual awareness and identify potential security concerns from a distance.
  • Lift or move objects weighing up to 20 pounds.

WHY JOIN SECURITAS?

At Securitas, you’ll be part of a global organization with more than 80 years of experience protecting the people and things that matter most.

Our employees enjoy:

  • $25.50 per hour
  • Weekly pay
  • Paid holidays

  • Employer-provided medical and dental coverage
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Voluntary life and disability insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Securitas Saves discount program
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

READY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP?

If you're an experienced security professional who takes pride in vigilance, professionalism, sound judgment, and exceptional service, we want to hear from you.

Apply online today and take the next step in your corporate security career with Securitas.

title: Digital & AI Transformation Lead
description:
Salary: $100,000 per year

About the role

AANT is embarking on an AI-driven transformation. We've invested in new technologies and systems that improve member insights and organisation performance, and we're now accelerating the adoption of AI to unlock value for members, employees and the business.

We're embracing AI to improve insights, reporting, workflows, member journeys and service delivery. It will help our people work smarter, make better decisions and focus on the work that creates the greatest value.

AI is only as good as the systems and data beneath it. That's why this role is also responsible for maximising the effectiveness of our new systems to further improve performance – making full use of our single view of members and customers, automating workflows, and working hand in hand with our technology partners to ensure our systems deliver tangible outcomes for members and staff.

As the Digital & AI Transformation Lead, you'll have the rare opportunity to build this capability from the ground up. You'll develop and lead a portfolio of AI and systems improvement initiatives that improve member experiences, lift productivity and create measurable business outcomes.

Working across technology, data, marketing, and governance, as well as our external partners, you'll help shape AI and digital capability across the organisation and help define the future of one of the Territory's most trusted organisations.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead AI adoption across AANT – identifying, prioritising and delivering AI initiatives that improve member experiences, insights, reporting and productivity

  • Find and automate high-volume, repetitive workflows across member services, reporting and internal operations

  • Maximise the effectiveness of our new CRM and broader systems to improve performance – driving staff adoption and using our single view of members and customers to improve service, insights and reporting

  • Work closely with our technology partner to ensure our systems deliver tangible outcomes – setting clear expectations, monitoring performance and making sure technology investment translates into measurable benefits

  • Strengthen data governance, cybersecurity and responsible AI practices as our digital footprint grows

  • Build digital and AI capability across the team, and track progress through clear measures of adoption, benefits and value

About you

You’re excited by the possibilities of AI, but equally focused on delivering practical outcomes. You’ll have a strong background in IT, and you understand that getting real value from AI and new systems is never just about technology – it depends on good data, sound processes and people who are ready to embrace new ways of working.

You’re a strategic thinker who can navigate complexity and translate emerging technologies into meaningful organisational outcomes. You’re commercially minded and comfortable holding technology partners to account for the value they deliver.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Experience leading AI, data, digital or business transformation initiatives in complex environments

  • A track record of getting the most out of systems such as CRM, cloud and collaboration platforms – lifting adoption, improving processes and delivering measurable business results

  • Experience managing technology vendors or managed service partners, including service levels, performance and value for money

  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills across technology, business and governance functions

  • An understanding of responsible AI, data governance, cybersecurity, risk and compliance frameworks required to scale AI safely and effectively

  • A passion for building capability, driving adoption and helping organisations embrace new ways of working

When you join AANT, you’ll have:

  • The opportunity to establish AANT’s AI initiatives and influence how AI is adopted across the organisation

  • A chance to shape the future of member service, decision-making and operational excellence through AI and our new systems

  • The opportunity to build organisation-wide AI and digital capability

  • A role at the centre of AANT’s strategic transformation agenda

  • The chance to help create an AI-enabled organisation where technology empowers people to do their best work

Benefits

We believe in rewarding our people for the work they do. As part of the AANT team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Generous discounts on Home, Car and Travel Insurance

  • Free AANT Premium Roadside Membership

  • Complimentary tickets to events at AANT Centre

  • Access to the AANT's Staff Wellbeing Program

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Ongoing Training & Development opportunities

About us

Since 1963, the Automobile Association of the Northern Territory (AANT) has been proudly servicing the motoring needs of Territorians. With over 20,000 members, our services span roadside assistance, insurance, salary packaging, expert motoring advice, and fantastic everyday savings.

We're more than just a service provider – we're your trusted voice in the community. We champion the issues that matter to you as road users. Whether it's at the Territory or Federal level, within government or industry, we strive to ensure competitive fuel prices, promote safer drivers, advocate for safer cars, and work towards safer roads.

How to Apply

Please apply through Seek, attaching your resume and a cover letter. For a copy of the position description, email MSmith4@aant.com.au

Applications close 9 November 2026.

title: Financial Operations Assistant
description:

PLEASE INCLUDE A COVER LETTER WITH YOUR APPLICATION DETAILING HOW YOU MEET THE REQUIRED EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION FOR THIS POSITION.
ALL QUALIFIED CANDIDATES WILL BE INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN TESTING FOR THIS POSITION. CANDIDATES MUST PASS THE REQUIRED EXAMINATION TO MOVE FORWARD IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS.

ALL CANDIDATES WHO PASS THE EXAMINATION WILL BE SCREENED TO ENSURE THEY MEET THE CIVIL SERVICE PRE-EMPLOYMENT SCREENING STANDARDS. PLEASE REVIEW THOSE STANDARDS HERE.

The Financial Operations Assistant performs technical, complex, and specialized financial, accounting, and fiscal services for the Thurston County Sheriff's Office. Responsibilities include posting complex financial data to general ledgers; assisting in the development and implementation of internal control systems; performing specialized payroll according to contracts, process and audit accounts payable, accounts receivable, travel and training employee reimbursements; maintaining encumbrances, inmate medical billing, support and provide information for budget preparation; reconciling and auditing bank accounts; performing cash handling; and monitoring and administering the inmate accounting system. May serve as a backup to the Accounting Manager and act in a lead capacity to volunteers and temporary/extra help staff.

Financial Operations Assistants may be assigned to one of the following assignments:

  • Payroll
  • Accounts Payable & Assets/Inventory
  • Inmate Medical Support
Financial Operations Assistants are expected to function with considerable independence and have latitude in exercising independent judgment within the framework of existing accounting policies and procedures. Work is performed under general supervision and may be reviewed periodically for adequacy and accuracy of records, reports, and functions.
Qualifications:
  • Must be at least 21 years of age at time of appointment.

  • Must possess a high school diploma or GED.
  • One year of college level accounting course work and two years of accounting work experience. Experience may substitute for education, and education for experience on a year-for-year basis.
