P. Terry's believes that the crewmembers are the backbone and foundation of our success. With that in mind we made the industry leading decision to pay our full-time crew members a $15.00 minimum wage after their first 90 days of full-time employment.
Community Involvement
Our reputation for giving does not stop with our employees; P. Terry's has given more than $1 million dollars back to local charities since its inception in 2005.

title: Compliance Auditor
description:
Position Summary


The Compliance Auditor is responsible for the review of the company and delegated entities’ business practices, enforcing compliance with pertinent regulations, such as all federal and state relevant regulations and standards, applicable contractual requirements established by the organization’s clients and internal policies and procedures. Such audits and/or monitoring may occur annually or at other intervals and may include reviewing documentation and other records, as well as interviewing executives and employees. In instances where a potential and/or current non-compliance with a regulation or set of regulations is identified, the Compliance Auditor is responsible for recommending improvements to business processes to ensure that the operational department comes into compliance. Additionally, the Compliance Auditor is charged with evaluating the plan to implement any needed change, ensuring that steps within the plan are effective and addressing the root cause of the non-compliance issue.


Duties and Responsibilities


• Promote a strong code of ethics and integrity.

• Stay abreast of changes in healthcare laws, regulations and standards, including, but not limited to, Medicare, Medicaid and Commercial regulations and advise the company of requirements and changes, if any, required to be implemented by the Company.

• Assist in risk/issue identification and remediation within the external and internal audits and delegation oversight audits.

• Resolve compliance issues identified through internal and/or external audits or monitoring, while working closely with all operational department leaders and/or delegated entities’ point of contact (POC) to ensure prompt response to the compliance issues and that effective procedures are in place.

• Responsible for monitoring and maintaining the quality of the audited processes performed in each of the departments in accordance with the applicable lines of business and specialty network while collaborating with the Compliance Officer to improve processes and mitigate risks.

• Responsible for analyzing, organizing and documenting the findings arising from the audit and/or monitoring exercises, preparing reports containing findings, and requesting and implementing corrective action plans.

• Conducting internal audits, developing quality indicators to measure standards, developing internal audit tools as necessary and presenting the results of evaluations/audit reports to the Compliance Officer.

• Handle and oversee all external audits, ensuring that all steps are performed in a timely manner, such as but not limited to: Universes, questionnaires, samples and any request for information review, analysis, audit notices dissemination to impacted operational departments, recommendations for correction, internal discussions, preparation of data for final submission and receipt of formal closing notice.

• Maintain organized and up to date all audits’ records within the organization’s systems.

• Promptly address any Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) and/or non-compliance issues identified through an external audit with applicable operational department leader and delegate POC, and ensure accurate, effective, and complete evidence of completion is provided to the health plan partner auditor in a timely manner.

• Maintain the Audits and CAPs log and its evidence updated and well organized.

• Adhere to organizational policies and procedures to ensure compliance with the Compliance Program and contractual requirements, while serving as a departmental liaison to assist with the functions of the Compliance Program.

• Provides training and guidance to staff and delegates on compliance-related matters.

• Comply with performance standards as set forth by the Compliance department head.

• Perform other duties as required and assigned.

title: Tunneling Project Manager (Construction)
description:
PACT (Pearson Accelerator Construction Team) is a General Partnership of Alberici, Amico, Kenaidan, and Obayashi, supported by design partners Egis, Mott MacDonald, and Weston Williamson + Partners. Together, we are delivering Accelerator, a major program of Pearson LIFT (Long-term Investment in Facilities and Terminals), Toronto Pearson's infrastructure development plan. This multi-year program is designed to address immediate passenger growth demands while preparing Canada’s largest airport for the future of air travel—including critical upgrades to airfield and infrastructure, greenhouse gas reduction initiatives, modernization of Terminals 1 and 3, and the creation of a world-class passenger experience.


JOB SUMMARY

The Tunneling Project Manager will oversee design, construction and technical coordination across the Spring Creek Culvert Tunnels, which will function as a relief system to the existing triple box culvert serving the north airfield complex. Within the challenging operational environment of an active airfield, the twin water conveyance tunnels are proposed to be constructed beneath runways, taxiways, and critical airport infrastructure using mechanized Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) methods, specifically micro-tunnelling techniques.

This role bridges engineering and field execution, providing leadership in design management, constructability reviews, stakeholder engagement, subcontractor management and delivery readiness to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant project execution.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and align multidisciplinary project teams comprised of internal resources and Joint Venture partners to achieve project objectives.
  • Provide leadership and direction to Project Coordinators, Tunnel Engineers, Construction Superintendents, and other project personnel.
  • Assume overall technical and commercial accountability for successful contract execution and delivery.
  • Oversee all phases of tunnel construction, ensuring adherence to safety, quality, budget, and schedule requirements.
  • Manage site operations, subcontractors, and field teams while coordinating closely with project engineers, designers, clients, and key stakeholders.
  • Ensure full compliance with project specifications, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
  • Monitor Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) performance, analyze operational data, and implement corrective actions to optimize productivity and efficiency.
  • Demonstrate strong leadership through clear communication of priorities, effective decision-making, proactive problem-solving, and issue resolution.
  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee airside tunnelling, civil works, and associated construction activities.
  • Foster a collaborative environment by empowering key team members and encouraging participation in project planning and decision-making.
  • Promote and maintain a strong safety culture, ensuring consistent application of health, safety, and progressive discipline policies across all project activities.
  • Ensure the successful delivery of all contractual obligations while meeting or exceeding client expectations and quality standards.
  • Maximize project profitability while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, quality, and the company's overall business interests.
  • Direct and manage projects from initiation through closeout, including workforce planning, subcontractor management, and overall project execution.
  • Develop, review, and oversee project budgets, construction methodologies, schedules, work plans, and technical submittals.
  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) program on site.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of tender documents, drawings, specifications, contract amendments, and project requirements to support successful project delivery.
  • Oversee project documentation and controls, including correspondence, RFIs, submittals, NCRs, change management, and contract records.
  • Ensure accurate preparation and maintenance of project closeout documentation, including as-built drawings, reports, presentations, and turnover packages.
  • Support and participate in field activities and site operations as required to ensure project objectives are achieved.
  • Assist in managing project budgets, mitigating risk exposure, and ensuring procurement and proposal development activities remain on schedule.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with subcontractors, suppliers, vendors, clients, and consultants throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and integrate the efforts of owners, architects, consultants, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure successful project execution.
  • Monitor construction progress, prepare regular performance reports, and lead project status meetings with clients, consultants, and project stakeholders.
  • Maintain strict adherence to corporate quality assurance and safety management standards.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative technologies, tunnelling techniques, and construction methodologies to improve productivity and project outcomes.
  • Support the development of post-award execution plans, procurement strategies, project schedules, and cost control initiatives.
  • Promote collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing across project and program teams.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required to support successful project delivery.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The position will be based at our office or site office in Mississauga, Ontario, with frequent visits to the Airport site as required. Your work schedule will be Monday to Friday during regular office or site hours. At times, operational needs may require work outside these hours, with reasonable notice provided. All schedule or on‑call adjustments will comply with applicable employment standards legislation. It is mandatory for all employees to complete a Criminal Background check and successfully attain a Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) and an Airside Vehicle Operator’s Permit (AVOP) upon joining the company.

DESIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, COMPETENCIES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) designation is considered a strong asset.
  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience managing the design and construction of major airfield, transportation, or civil infrastructure projects.
  • 5+ years of experience delivering mechanized tunnelling projects utilizing Tunnel Boring Machines (TBM) and Micro TBM technologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of Tunnel Boring Machine operations, tunnelling systems, and associated mechanical, civil, and geotechnical engineering principles.
  • Extensive field experience in tunnelling operations, including Micro TBM, Slurry TBM, Earth Pressure Balance (EPB), and conventional mined tunnel construction methods.
  • Demonstrated experience in tunnel excavation management, including both on-site supervision and remote performance monitoring.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a Project Manager, Construction Manager, or equivalent leadership role within heavy civil construction, mining, underground infrastructure, or related sectors.
  • Ability and willingness to work in active construction environments, including underground tunnel and confined-space settings.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, AutoCAD, and Bluebeam; experience with Primavera P6 scheduling software is considered an asset.
  • Strong technical and commercial acumen, with the ability to assess engineering and construction decisions in relation to project cost, risk, schedule, and overall business objectives.
  • Proven leadership capabilities with exceptional communication, coordination, stakeholder management, and team development skills.
  • Experience utilizing project management, digital collaboration, and document control platforms within large-scale infrastructure projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex project environment while delivering high-quality results.
  • Strong commitment to health and safety, operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Valid driver’s license and eligibility for RAIC clearance and AVOP required.


PACT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free candidate experience and work environment. If you require accommodation to apply or if selected to participate in an assessment process, please advise Human Resources.

title: CON 2026/35 - Local Consultant for the Development of a Specialized Training Module for Labor Inspectors
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration


Project Context and Scope

Danish Western Balkans Regional Migration Governance Programme (RMGP) – Focus on Western Balkans and Republic of Türkiye – Outcome 2 (IB0537)

The International Organization for Migration (IOM) will support an assessment of the current situation, including existing capacities, training needs, operational practices and institutional arrangements relevant to labor inspections, trafficking in persons and labor exploitation. The findings of this assessment will inform the subsequent development of a specialized training module to strengthen the capacity of labor inspectors to identify, respond to and refer cases involving indicators of trafficking in persons and labor exploitation.

The local consultant will work as part of a team with the international consultant to ensure that the training module reflects the Albanian legal, institutional, and operational context, including the roles and responsibilities of labor inspectorates, law enforcement institutions, referral structures, and relevant case management procedures.

Working under the overall supervision of IOM Albania and in close coordination with the Labor Inspectorate and the International Consultant, the Local Consultant will support the assessment of the current situation, contribute to the development of a specialized training module for labor inspectors, and support the organization of a Training of Trainers (ToT).

Organizational Department / Unit to which the Consultant is contributing

Danish Western Balkans Regional Migration Governance Programme (RMGP) – Focus on Western Balkans and Republic of Türkiye – Outcome 2 (IB0537)
Tasks to be performed under this contract
  • The Local Consultant will focus first on assessing the current situation, including national contextualization, legal and institutional analysis, operational practices, stakeholder perspectives and training needs. Based on this assessment, the consultant will provide inputs to the development of practical inspection tools, training materials and the co-facilitation of the Training of Trainers. The International Consultant will provide overall technical guidance, comparative expertise and quality assurance, while the Local Consultant will ensure that the assessment and subsequent module are fully aligned with Albania’s legal, institutional and operational context and are practical for use by labor inspectors.
    The consultant will be responsible for the following tasks:
    • Conduct an assessment of the current situation, including existing capacities, training needs, operational practices, institutional roles and key challenges faced by labor inspectors in identifying and responding to indicators of trafficking in persons and labor exploitation.
    • Review existing national legislation, policies, institutional mandates, operational procedures, and training materials relevant to labor inspection, trafficking in persons, labor exploitation, referral mechanisms, and case management.
    • Support the international consultant in identifying training needs and contextual priorities for labor inspectors in Albania.
    • Contribute to the drafting and contextualization of the specialized training module, ensuring alignment with Albanian legislation and institutional practice.
    • Provide national-level inputs on the identification of trafficking and labor exploitation indicators during labor inspections.
    • Develop practical tools, exercises, case studies, checklists, and guidance materials for labor inspectors.
    • Contribute to the design of sessions on selecting, planning, and conducting professional inspections in suspected cases of labor exploitation and trafficking.
    • Develop guidance on planning and conducting joint inspections involving labor inspectorates, police, and other relevant institutions.
    • Ensure that referral pathways and inspection case management procedures are accurately reflected in the module.
    • Conduct consultations and validation meetings with labor inspectorates, police and other relevant stakeholders.
    • Co-facilitate the Training of Trainers in Tirana together with the international consultant.
    • Incorporate feedback from IOM, the Labor Inspectorate and national stakeholders into the final training module and related materials.
    Key deliverables (indicative):

  • No.

    		Deliverable

    Working days

    1

    		Assessment and inception note completed, outlining the current situation, training needs, methodology, workplan and agreed division of tasks with the Local Consultant.

    6 days

    2

    		Draft specialized training module prepared, incorporating assessment findings, international standards, practical tools, case studies, exercises and referral guidance.

    8 days

    3

    		ToT co-facilitated and final training package completed, incorporating feedback from IOM, the Labour Inspectorate, the Local Consultant and relevant stakeholders.

    6 days

    Total

    20 working days

Performance indicators for the evaluation of results
• Assigned deliverables are completed within the agreed timeframe and meet IOM quality standards.
• Information and analysis are accurate, well documented and directly relevant to the objectives of the assignment.
• Stakeholder consultations are conducted in a professional, respectful and inclusive manner, and the outcomes are summarized clearly.
• Written inputs are analytical, concise and grounded in Albania’s institutional and policy context.
• Inputs are provided on time and in a format that supports consolidation by the International Consultant and review by IOM and national counterparts.
• Deliverables are submitted according to the timelines outlined above and reflect agreed technical requirements.
• Demonstrates effective teamwork and coordination with IOM, the International Consultant and national counterparts.
• Maintains clear, timely and professional communication throughout the assignment.
• Maintains confidentiality and handles sensitive information in accordance with IOM standards.
• Demonstrates timeliness, responsibility and initiative in completing assigned tasks.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

• Advanced university degree in social sciences, public administration, human rights, labor relations, criminal justice, or another relevant field.

Experience

• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in migration, trafficking in persons, employment sector, protection, social inclusion, and institutional capacity development.

Skills

• Sound knowledge of Albanian legislation and institutional frameworks related to labor inspection, trafficking in persons, labor exploitation, referral mechanisms, and victim protection.
• Extensive experience in developing training programmes, training content, SOPs, guidance materials and practical tools for public institutions and service providers.
• Extensive experience working with ministries, local authorities, law-enforcement-related structures, referral mechanisms and other national stakeholders, including facilitation of consultations and capacity-building activities.
• Strong analytical, drafting, facilitation and communication skills demonstrated through numerous national and international consultancy assignments
• Ability to maintain accuracy and confidentiality in performing responsibilities.
• Strong interpersonal and intercultural skills with attention to detail.

Languages

For this consultancy, Fluency in Albanian and English is required for this assignment.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Notes

IOM covers Consultants against occupational accidents and illnesses under the Compensation Plan (CP), free of charge, for the duration of the consultancy. IOM does not provide evacuation or medical insurance for reasons related to non-occupational accidents and illnesses. Consultants are responsible for their own medical insurance for non-occupational accident or illness and will be required to provide written proof of such coverage before commencing work.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: Administrator / Administratrice/administrateur
description:
Position: Administrator

Reports To: Senior Manager, Corporate Administration

Classification Level: Level 1 (Administration)


This role will remain open until October 22nd, 2026 or till a successful candidate is found, whichever comes first.


Position Summary
The Administrator provides administrative, operational, and office coordination support to Sport Integrity Canada. The role is responsible for maintaining efficient office operations, supporting organizational activities, supporting meetings and events, managing inventory and supplies, and ensuring administrative systems and processes are effective and well maintained.
The Administrator serves as a resource for employees, vendors, and stakeholders by supporting day-to-day business operations, facilities management, records administration, and organizational initiatives.


Duties and Responsibilities
Office Administration and Facilities Coordination
• Ensure offices, meeting rooms, common areas, kitchen spaces, and storage areas remain clean, organized, safe, and professional.
• Conduct regular inspections of workspaces and common areas to identify housekeeping, maintenance, security, and safety concerns.
• Coordinate routine office maintenance requirements and building-related issues with the landlord and external service providers, escalating complex matters to the Senior Manager, Corporate Administration as required.
• Maintain office parking pass inventory.
• Assist with workspace set up, office reconfigurations, and storage organization as required.


Organizational Administration and Operations Support
• Maintain centralized electronic and physical filing systems in accordance with organizational procedures.
• Provide administrative support across the organization, including the preparation, coordination, and distribution of documents, reports, correspondence, and other materials as required.
• Prepare expense claims for the Executive Team.
• Organize all staff travel and coordination with travel agent.


Meeting, Event, and Hospitality Support
• Coordinate meeting logistics including room bookings, catering, hospitality services, equipment, and materials.
• Provide administrative support for meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, and document distribution as required.
• Support Board and committee meetings through administrative and logistical coordination.
• Assist with preparing meeting packages, resource kits, and supporting materials as needed.
• Draft meeting minutes and correspondence as required.
• Support corporate events, staff meetings, and organizational initiatives.


Inventory and Shipments
• Process incoming and outgoing mail and maintain mail-tracking records.
• Maintain inventory records and related documentation for office and program supplies, including materials stored off-site.
• Identify outdated or obsolete materials for disposal or archiving to Senior Manager, Corporate Administration.
• Maintain required documentation and electronic inventory records.


Communications and Correspondence Management
• Monitor and triage inquiries received through the organization's general email inbox and forward them to the appropriate employee or team.
• Assist with the preparation, formatting, and distribution of correspondence and documents.
• Maintain organizational contact lists and distribution groups.
• Ensure correspondence and related records are filed and retained in accordance with organizational procedure.


General Responsibilities
• Comply with organizational policies, procedures, and quality standards, and support continuous improvement activities, documentation requirements, stakeholder feedback processes, and corrective actions as required.
• Other duties assigned by the Senior Manager, Corporate Administration and/or Director, Finance, Human Resources, Administration.


Qualifications and Competencies
• High school or college diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience in a relevant position.
• Three or more years of on-the-job experience and/or performing similar duties required, with knowledge of the Canadian sport community preferred.
• Strong communication skills in both English and French (verbal and written).
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to learn quickly and self-motivate while working independently and/or collaborating as part of a team.
• Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and accuracy, ability to follow procedures, time management skills, ability to coordinate multiple priorities.
• Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, the Internet, data entry, and word processing.


Applications for this position should be submitted electronically on BambooHR by October 22nd, 2026. We thank all applicants for their interest but only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.


Artificial intelligence tools are not used to screen, assess, or select applicants for this role.

For more information about Sport Integrity Canada, please visit Home | Sport Integrity Canada.


Throughout its recruitment process, Sport Integrity Canada is committed to Canada’s linguistic duality and diversity of its people. We welcome expressions of interest from all qualified applicants including Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, members of visible minority groups, and all gender identities and sexual orientations. Upon request, accommodation will be provided during the hiring process.



Poste : Administratrice/administrateur
Relève de : Gestionnaire principale
Catégorie : Niveau 1 (Administration)


Ce poste demeurera affiché jusqu’au 22 octobre 2026 ou jusqu’à ce qu’un candidat retenu soit trouvé, selon la première éventualité.


Description du poste

La personne titulaire du poste assure le soutien administratif et opérationnel de Sport Intégrité Canada, ainsi que la coordination de ses activités de bureau. Elle est responsable d’assurer le bon fonctionnement des bureaux, d’appuyer les activités de l’organisation, de fournir un soutien lors des réunions et des événements, de gérer les stocks et les fournitures, et de veiller à ce que les systèmes et les processus administratifs soient efficaces et à jour
Elle agit également à titre de personne-ressource auprès du personnel, des fournisseurs et des parties prenantes en assurant le soutien des activités opérationnelles quotidiennes, de la gestion des installations, de l’administration des dossiers et des initiatives organisationnelles.


Rôles et responsabilités

Administration des bureaux et coordination des installations
• Veiller à ce que les bureaux, les salles de réunion, les espaces communs, les cuisines et les espaces de rangement restent propres, bien rangés, sécuritaires et professionnels.
• Effectuer des inspections régulières des lieux de travail et des espaces communs afin de repérer les problèmes liés à l’entretien ménager, à l’entretien des installations, et à la sécurité.
• Coordonner l’entretien courant des bureaux et les questions liées à l’immeuble avec le propriétaire et les fournisseurs de services externes, en transmettant les dossiers complexes à la gestionnaire principale au besoin.
• Tenir à jour l’inventaire des laissez-passer de stationnement.
• Aider à l’aménagement des postes de travail, à la réorganisation des bureaux et à l’organisation des espaces de rangement, au besoin.
• Assurer les activités de réception et coordonner l’accès aux bureaux conformément aux procédures de l’organisation.


Administration organisationnelle et soutien opérationnel
• Tenir à jour les systèmes de classement centralisés électroniques et physiques, conformément aux procédures de l’organisation.
• Fournir un soutien administratif à l’ensemble de l’organisation, notamment en assurant la préparation, la coordination et la distribution des documents, des rapports, de la correspondance et de tout autre matériel nécessaire.
• Préparer les demandes de remboursement des frais pour l’équipe de direction.
• Organiser tous les déplacements du personnel et assurer la coordination avec les agences de voyages.


Soutien aux réunions, aux événements et à l’accueil
• Coordonner l’organisation logistique des réunions, notamment la réservation des salles, la restauration, les services d’accueil, l’équipement et le matériel.
• Fournir un soutien administratif pour les réunions, notamment en ce qui concerne la planification, la préparation de l’ordre du jour et la distribution des documents, au besoin.
• Assurer la coordination administrative et logistique des réunions du conseil d’administration et des comités.
• Aider à la préparation des dossiers de réunion, des trousses de ressources et du matériel d’appui, au besoin.
• Rédiger les procès-verbaux des réunions et la correspondance, au besoin.
• Appuyer les événements d’entreprise, les réunions du personnel et les initiatives organisationnelles.


Stocks et expéditions
• Traiter le courrier entrant et sortant et tenir à jour les registres de suivi du courrier.
• Tenir à jour les registres d’inventaire et la documentation connexe concernant les fournitures de bureau et de programme, y compris le matériel entreposé à l’extérieur des locaux.
• Identifier le matériel obsolète à éliminer ou à archiver, puis en informer la gestionnaire principale
• Tenir à jour la documentation requise et les registres d’inventaire électroniques.


Gestion des communications et de la correspondance
• Surveiller et trier les demandes reçues dans la boîte de réception générale de l’organisation, puis les transmettre à la personne ou à l’équipe concernée.
• Aider à la préparation, à la mise en page et à la distribution de la correspondance et des documents.
• Tenir à jour les listes de contacts et les groupes de distribution de l’organisation.
• Veiller à ce que la correspondance et les documents connexes soient classés et conservés conformément aux procédures de l’organisation.

Responsabilités générales
• Se conformer aux politiques, aux procédures et aux normes de qualité de l’organisation, et appuyer les activités d’amélioration continue, les exigences en matière de documentation, les processus de rétroaction des parties prenantes et les mesures correctives, au besoin.
• S’acquitter d’autres tâches assignées par la gestionnaire principale et/ou la direction, Finances, ressources humaines et administration.


Exigences
• Diplôme d’études secondaires ou postsecondaires, ou combinaison équivalente d’études et d’expérience pertinentes.
• Plus de trois ans d’expérience dans un poste pertinent ou d’exercice de fonctions similaires; connaissance du milieu sportif canadien, un atout.
• Bonnes compétences de communication orale et écrite en anglais et en français.
• Entregent, initiative, capacité d’apprendre rapidement et de travailler de façon autonome et en équipe.
• Excellent sens de l’organisation, souci du détail, précision, capacité de suivre des procédures, bonne gestion du temps, capacité de coordonner des priorités multiples.
• Maîtrise de MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, d’Internet, de la saisie de données et du traitement de texte.


Les candidatures doivent être soumises électroniquement par l’entremise de BambooHR au plus tard le 22 octobre 2026. Nous remercions toutes les personnes candidates de leur intérêt; toutefois, seules les personnes retenues pour une entrevue seront contactées.


Les outils d’intelligence artificielle ne sont pas utilisés pour présélectionner, évaluer ou sélectionner les personnes candidates pour ce poste.

Dans l’ensemble de son processus de recrutement, Sport Intégrité Canada reconnaît la dualité linguistique du Canada et la diversité de sa population. Nous encourageons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, notamment les Autochtones, les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des minorités visibles ainsi que les personnes de toutes les identités de genre et orientations sexuelles. Des mesures d’adaptation seront offertes sur demande tout au long du processus de recrutement.

title: ERS-NETA Electrical Testing Technician - Kansas City, MO
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Troubleshoot, test, and inspect electrical apparatus. Perform as “lead” person on projects. Perform other assignments as required. Position requires some technical supervision.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all aspects of testing and maintenance of electrical power distribution systems.
  • Troubleshooting capabilities, simple relay calibration, use of load recording instrumentation, low and medium voltage switchgear testing through 15 kV class.
  • Test and troubleshoot moderately complex electrical systems, simple relay systems and power metering.
  • May perform simple power system studies including short circuit and protective device coordination.
  • Write complete, detailed reports promptly at end of project using a computer, and accurately process job billing.

title: EDM Managed Services Consultant
description:
About Rimes

Rimes provides the Intelligence Fabric for Capital Markets, a trusted data network and intelligence architecture that transforms fragmented data, operations and workflows into decision-grade intelligence. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers, and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions that power more than US$ 75 trillion in AUM annually.

About Rimes: Rimes provides enterprise data management solutions to the global investment community. Driven by our passion for solving the most complex data problems, we provide our clients with investment intelligence that powers more than US$75 trillion in assets under management annually. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions using accurate information and industry-leading technology.

The Opportunity: Join our global Client Services team and play a key role in delivering high‑quality enterprise data management services to the world’s leading investment organisations. You will work at the intersection of data, technology, and client service, helping to ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and reliability of critical financial data across a complex, global operating model.

As part of our EDM Managed Services function, you will collaborate with colleagues across regions to monitor service flows, resolve data issues, support clients, and uphold robust operational and control standards. The role offers exposure to a wide range of asset classes, datasets, and technologies, as well as opportunities to develop technical expertise, deepen domain knowledge, and grow responsibility over time. Whether you are building foundational experience or taking on broader ownership and leadership, this is an opportunity to contribute to a mission‑critical service, work with diverse stakeholders, and progress your career within a growing, global organization.

At the Consultant level, this role provides the opportunity to take greater ownership of operational outcomes and work independently across more complex scenarios. You will deepen your expertise in data workflows, service oversight, and client issue resolution, while coordinating across teams and regions. This role is well‑suited to individuals ready to apply judgement, manage complexity, and contribute to service improvement, while continuing to build influence and leadership capability.

What You Will Do

Training, Procedures & Professional Standards

  • Apply established procedures and operational standards consistently, taking ownership for end‑to‑end task completion.

Service Flow Monitoring & Operational Delivery

  • Monitor key service flows and conduct detailed investigations into failures, delays, and data quality issues.
  • Proactively escalate operational risks or recurring service disruptions.
  • Provide oversight to ensure handovers between teams are clear, complete, and well documented.

Exceptions & Data Quality Management

  • Act as Maker and/or Checker depending on exception complexity.
  • Review exception trends and escalate systemic or high‑risk issues for further analysis.

Client & Stakeholder Query Handling (RSD)

  • Manage and resolve complex client and stakeholder queries requiring detailed investigation.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and escalate cases requiring specialist expertise or approval.

Incident Management

  • Initiate and manage incident tickets for operational failures or disruptions.
  • Coordinate resolution activities across internal teams and provide status updates as required.

Controls & Compliance

  • Perform assigned activities within the control framework to maintain operational integrity.
  • Identify and highlight risks, near‑misses, or control gaps through oversight reporting.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Provide oversight of operational and governance reporting.
  • Support the creation, refresh, and accuracy of performance and control reports.

Workload & Service Discipline

  • Maintain weekly updates to team task trackers, including project work, training, and bank holidays.
  • Support workload planning and forecasting to reflect operational demand.

Change & Weekend Support

  • Support regression testing and operational readiness during change events.
  • Participate in scheduled or weekend support rotations as required.

Who You Are

  • Applied understanding of EDM Services, data ingestion, data processing, and related operational workflows, enabling independent decision‑making and informed trade‑offs when resolving issues.
  • Independently analyses complex data workflows and identifies root causes and improvement opportunities.
  • Deep understanding of EDM Services and the value they deliver to clients.
  • Solid experience managing issues in a client‑facing environment—internally or externally.
  • Can acts as a reliable deputy, coordinating across teams and maintaining service continuity.
  • Amenable to work in a hybrid set up, 3x a week RTO.
  • Can do APAC Shift

What You Will Gain

  • Technical & market development: Continued training in Python and Rimes’ selected technologies, plus exposure to equity and fixed‑income indices, ESG datasets, ratings, and corporate actions.
  • Develop deep familiarity with datasets to support complex queries and issue resolution.
  • Gain experience contributing to oversight and control improvement.
  • Broader exposure to ESG, equity and fixed‑income indices, ratings, and corporate actions.
  • Growth in operational leadership and cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Professional growth: Build adaptability, resilience, and partnership skills in a fast‑paced and evolving environment.

Only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews. We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for considering a career with us.

Rimes is committed to promote the values of diversity and inclusion throughout the business. Whether it’s through recruitment, retention, career progression or training and development, we are committed to improving opportunities for people regardless of their background or circumstances.

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Job Title: Senior Estimator
Location: Carlsbad, CA


Company Overview

At Nevell Group, Inc. (NGi), we are a leader in the commercial construction industry, specializing in interior and exterior wall systems. With a reputation built on integrity, craftsmanship, and innovation, NGi delivers high-quality results across diverse markets including healthcare, education, and commercial construction.

We take pride in fostering a collaborative and dynamic work environment where our team is committed to delivering excellence on every project.

Why Join NGi

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package – 100% paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • 401(k) with company match and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Collaborative and growth-focused culture
  • Opportunity to work on high-profile and challenging commercial projects

About the Role

Nevell Group, Inc. is seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Senior Estimator to join our Preconstruction Team in Carlsbad, CA.

This position plays a key role in the success of our estimating efforts, responsible for developing accurate and competitive estimates for large-scale commercial wall system projects. The Senior Estimator will analyze drawings, specifications, and other documentation to determine project costs while leading estimating initiatives that support NGi’s continued growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead preparation of detailed estimates for interior and exterior wall system projects
  • Interpret and analyze plans, specifications, and contract documents to define project scope
  • Develop quantity take-offs, pricing strategies, and bid proposals
  • Collaborate with project managers, architects, engineers, and clients during preconstruction
  • Analyze historical cost data and market conditions to ensure accuracy and competitiveness
  • Manage bid schedules, subcontractor outreach, and vendor coordination
  • Identify risks, value engineering opportunities, and constructability considerations
  • Mentor and develop junior estimators within the team

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred
  • 7+ years of experience in commercial construction estimating, preferably in wall systems (drywall, framing, plaster, etc.)

Technical Skills & Software

  • Proficient in On-Screen Takeoff (OST), Bluebeam, and other estimating or accounting software
  • Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with scheduling software is a plus

Qualifications & Attributes

  • Deep understanding of construction methods, materials, and bid processes
  • Exceptional analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines simultaneously
  • Demonstrated leadership and mentoring ability within a team environment
  • Collaborative mindset and attention to detail

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic construction environment

title: Business Insights Analyst
description:
As the Business Insights Analyst, you will be responsible for building capability in working with large and complex data sets to evaluate, recommend, and support the implementation of business strategies. You will be responsible for building knowledge of the company, processes, business systems and customers to analyze business processes, identify requirements and proposing solutions to meet the needs of the business. You may be asked to solve a range of straightforward problems and analyze possible solutions to said problems by using standard procedures. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insight, and insight into business decisions.

Primary responsibilities include

  • Provide analyses and reports to identify trends and insights and formulate recommendations that will influence business decisions. Conduct industry and competitive research, perform data quality assurance checks, manipulate and analyze large amounts of data, and prepare client ready spreadsheets and presentations.
  • Ensure accuracy of results and analytic methods through testing and validation of underlying report data. Ensure bias and data quality issues are resolved or explained when communication occurs.
  • Identify business opportunities and opportunities for optimization through analysis of large, complex data sets.
  • Provide recurring and ad hoc research to support various business lines and internal partners' initiatives.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal partners and teammates. Work with technical and development partners to deliver solutions based on outlined requirements.

Qualifications, Education, Certifications and/or Other Professional Credentials

  • 2-3 years professional experience in an analytical role
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, changing environment and to adapt while focusing on key goals and objectives
  • Proven proficiency with numbers and analytics, experience in analyzing large amounts of data, and an ability to translate that data into business insights
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to operate independently
  • Experience with market research, analyzing consumer behavior, or consulting
  • Bachelor's Degree in marketing, business administration, or quantitative field

Hours & Work Schedule

  • Hours per Week: 40
  • Work Schedule: Monday - Friday

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $78,000 - $106,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn additional incentive earnings. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. title: Field Service
description:
What You'll Do

  • Install, start up, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair industrial packaging equipment
  • Diagnose and resolve mechanical, pneumatic, and electrical issues at customer facilities
  • Train operators and maintenance personnel on proper equipment operation and maintenance
  • Read and interpret schematics, blueprints, and technical documentation
  • Provide exceptional customer service while representing CV-Tek professionally
  • Complete service reports and communicate findings to management and engineering teams
  • Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Customer Support to resolve technical issues
  • Assist customers both onsite and remotely with troubleshooting and support

Training Program

The first three months of employment will be spent at our Elgin facility, working alongside our assembly team and building equipment from the ground up.

This hands-on training provides a deep understanding of our machinery and prepares technicians to confidently support customers in the field.

What We're Looking For

  • Technical degree, Associate degree, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Experience with OEM equipment, industrial machinery, automation, packaging equipment, or other capital equipment.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude with a passion for troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 80%, including overnight and weekend travel.
  • Comfortable building relationships with customers and serving as the face of CV-Tek in the field.
  • Motivated self-starter who thrives in an independent work environment and takes ownership of results.

Travel & Schedule Expectations

This position requires approximately 80% travel, including frequent overnight travel.

Successful candidates must be comfortable with:

  • Extensive travel throughout the United States and Canada
  • Occasional international travel
  • Working independently at customer facilities
  • Weekend travel and weekend work as customer schedules require
  • Extended hours when necessary to support installations, startups, and emergency service calls

Candidates seeking a traditional local, Monday-Friday position will likely not find this role to be a good fit.

This is not a traditional Monday-Friday, 8-to-5 position. Flexibility and responsiveness are essential to success in this role.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work on advanced automation and packaging equipment
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and machine innovation
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
  • Overtime opportunities
  • Paid holiday and PTO
  • Extensive hands-on training
  • Opportunity to travel and work directly with customers across North America
  • High degree of autonomy and responsibility

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong mechanical aptitude
  • Experience working with mechanical, pneumatic, and electrical systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems independently
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Ability to make sound decisions with minimal supervision
  • Valid driver's license
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid passport

Preferred

  • Industrial maintenance, packaging machinery, automation, manufacturing, or field service experience
  • Experience reading electrical schematics and technical drawings
  • PLC troubleshooting experience, including exposure to Allen-Bradley/Rockwell platforms
  • Associate degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
  • Bilingual English/Spanish

Compensation

  • Base compensation: $32-38 per hour depending on experience, plus overtime opportunities

title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail


How You’ll Grow

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you.


What You Get

  • Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product
  • Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs
  • A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers
  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Hybrid setup based in our Munich office, with regular in-person days alongside the team


The Application

Send us your CV and portfolio — we don't do long forms or generic cover letters. Surprise us.

title: Archives & Special Collections Research Services Librarian
description:
Davidson College seeks an Archives & Special Collections Research Services Librarian to shape the researcher experience, ensure equitable access to collections, and foster engagement with departmental materials. Serving as a collaborative member of the Archives & Special Collections team, this position will play a pivotal role in connecting learners with collections in Davidson’s new George Lawrence Abernethy Library by managing the reading room, conducting research consultations, developing and implementing access policies, mentoring student employees, and creating in-person and online outreach programs that expand access to rare and unique materials across campus and in the community.

Reporting to the Assistant Director for Archives and Special Collections, the Research Services Librarian will:

  • Coordinate the research services and outreach program of the Archives & Special Collections;
  • Respond to reference requests and conduct research consultations for students, staff, faculty, alumni, and community members;
  • Manage the Archives & Special Collections reading room to ensure a welcoming and accessible space for all researchers;
  • Develop and supervise a program of student employees who support the department’s research services, including reading room staffing, peer-to-peer research support, reference digitization, and material shelving and retrieval;
  • Maintain the Archives & Special Collections website and develop social media content to facilitate access to materials and encourage awareness of collections, services, and programs;
  • Work with faculty, staff, and students to connect research and outreach services with the college’s Reconciliation and Education initiatives;
  • Design and deliver co-curricular and community workshops and programs;
  • Lead tours of departmental spaces and collections;
  • Create, update, and implement reference, access, and digitization policies and procedures;
  • Ensure effective retrieval and transport of departmental materials via workflows, policies, and systems;
  • Collect and share statistics to inform departmental services and collection development;
  • Provide support for colleagues creating exhibits and researching collections and potential donations;
  • Curate the college and local Davidsoniana file collections;
  • Serve on assigned library and campus committees, steering groups, and project groups;
  • Monitor national trends, advances, and best practices in research services, archival access and outreach, and student training; evaluate the potential application of these strategies to the Davidson College Archives & Special Collections; and
  • Other duties as assigned.

For this job, we require:

  • Master’s Degree in Library and Information Science from an ALA-accredited program
  • Experience answering and managing reference requests from a wide variety of learners with varying levels of research experience
  • Familiarity with library and archival access systems such as Primo and ArchivesSpace
  • Experience supervising, mentoring, or coaching young adults in academic, professional, or co-curricular contexts
  • Demonstrated interest in connecting learners with library and archival resources through creative outreach programs

Qualities that will help you flourish in this role:

  • You are enthusiastic about connecting undergraduate learners with materials from the Archives & Special Collections
  • You are a thoughtful, open-minded, collaborative colleague with strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • You are motivated, adaptable, resilient, and able to change direction as the library landscape evolves
  • You cultivate an optimistic mindset
  • You are able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
  • You are highly organized with strong project management skills
  • You are committed to creating an inclusive environment that values and celebrates difference

This position is full-time with a competitive compensation package.

About Us

In Fall 2027, the college’s new George Lawrence Abernethy Library will transform how our campus community learns, creates, and connects. Guided by our organizational values, we work to advance the college’s purpose in developing disciplined and creative minds for lives of leadership and service. We do this by offering expertise, space, resources, and services that facilitate research, provide access to, and foster the creation of knowledge.

Our library staff play a critical role in expanding the global reach of traditional scholarship, preserving born-digital materials, supporting digital scholarship, and championing equitable and sustainable access to information. As Davidson embarks on a transformative campus-wide strategic plan, we are excited to explore how our expertise, programs, and resources will advance the college’s key priorities. We take pride in our collaborations with campus partners such as the John Crosland Jr. Center for Teaching and Learning, the Jay Hurt Hub for Innovation and Entrepreneurship, and the D.G. and Harriet Wall Martin Institute for Public Good– strategic alliances that highlight the library's central role in the teaching and learning mission.

We are inspired by the college's public commitment to education and reconciliation. To create an inclusive learning community and to reflect the diversity of Davidson experiences, we collaborate on projects that tell the full history of our college, develop collections in partnership with students and faculty, and create meaningful community connections. We seek a thoughtful colleague who joins us in embracing a special set of responsibilities as we articulate the college's relationship to the past, confront our present moment, and chart a hopeful future.

Davidson is a highly selective, nationally ranked, residential liberal arts college located in Davidson, North Carolina, near Charlotte. We seek to hire talented faculty and staff who are committed to achieving excellence within an inclusive community where diverse backgrounds and perspectives are valued.
