title: CON 2026/33 - Senior Consultant for EU Integration and Diaspora Expertise Coordination
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration


Project Context and Scope

Albania’s European Union accession process has entered an increasingly demanding phase, requiring stronger coordination across institutions, sustained analytical capacity and effective follow-up of commitments across negotiating clusters and chapters. At the same time, labour migration and regular labour pathways are increasingly relevant to Albania’s broader migration governance and EU approximation priorities. The consultant will therefore support the General Secretariat for European Integration in its centre-of-government coordination role, while also facilitating the effective use of Albanian diaspora expertise to contribute to analytical work, policy inputs, implementation follow-up and institutional learning. The project contributes to ongoing efforts to strengthen Albania’s migration governance framework, including by reinforcing policy, institutional and regulatory capacities related to regular labour pathways, labour mobility and the effective engagement of Albanian diaspora expertise in priority reform processes. Within this framework, the consultancy will provide both embedded technical support to the General Secretariat for European Integration at the Prime Minister’s Office and coordination support for Albanian Diaspora Experts engaged in the EU approximation process, ensuring that their inputs are demand-driven, coherent, high quality and aligned with institutional needs.

Organizational Department / Unit to which the Consultant is contributing

The consultancy will contribute to the successful realization of the project "Enhancing Policy and Regulatory Frameworks to Strengthen Regular Labour Pathways for Migrant Workers in Albania” (LM0620) through the support of the IOM Development Fund. WBL 1:3:2:001
Tasks to be performed under this contract
  • Lead Albanian Diaspora Experts Engaged
    • Pro-actively outreach and identify priority needs of potential beneficiary institutions in coordination, ensuring coherence with the profiles and functions of Diaspora Experts engaged under the project.
    • Get well acquainted with IOM’s pool of potential Diaspora fellows and propose suitable candidates to IOM for placement to potential beneficiary institutions.
    • Develop tailored Terms of Reference for Diaspora Experts in consultation with potential beneficiary institutions and IOM, defining expected outputs, timelines, reporting arrangements and coordination modalities.
    • Coordinate and guide the work of Albanian Diaspora Experts engaged under the consultancy framework, ensuring that their contributions respond to the needs of the General Secretariat for European Integration, relevant line ministries, agencies and other stakeholders involved in EU approximation and labour migration-related reform processes.
    • Support the review, where needed, and quality-assure technical inputs, research notes, reports, institutional analyses and other outputs prepared by Diaspora Experts, ensuring that they are relevant to agreed terms of reference, methodologically sound and suitable for use by beneficiary institutions.
    • Monitor the engagement, performance and contribution of Diaspora Experts to beneficiary institutions, assessing the relevance, quality and added value of their support and identifying opportunities for improvement.
    • Prepare regular progress updates and monthly reports to IOM, outlining activities undertaken, progress achieved by Diaspora Experts, specific requests received from beneficiary institutions, challenges encountered and recommendations for strengthening the effectiveness and sustainability of the support provided.
    • Prepare a Final Consultancy Report summarizing:
    • The contributions and achievements of the Team Leader and Diaspora Experts in supporting EU acquis alignment;
    • The quality and relevance of outputs produced;
    • Coordination challenges encountered;
    • Lessons learned and recommendations for follow-up support.
  • Support the General Secretariat for European Integration, Prime Minister’s Office
    • Provide embedded technical and analytical support to the General Secretariat for European Integration in relation to Albania’s EU accession priorities, with particular attention to migration governance, labour mobility, regular labour pathways.
    • Support the preparation of notes, briefings, dashboards, progress summaries, coordination tools and other analytical products required by the General Secretariat for European Integration and relevant senior-level coordination mechanisms.
    • Facilitate coordination between the General Secretariat for European Integration, IOM, line ministries, agencies, ASPA and other relevant partners, including by supporting periodic consultations, information exchange and follow-up on emerging institutional needs.
    • Develop and apply common methodologies, templates, working arrangements and reporting practices to strengthen consistency, quality and coherence across accession-related and labour migration-related coordination processes.
    • Contribute to institutional learning and knowledge transfer by identifying relevant practices and lessons from EU Member States and comparable accession contexts, and by supporting their adaptation to Albania’s institutional and policy environment where appropriate.
Performance indicators for the evaluation of results
  • The consultant will be evaluated based on:
  • the quality and coherence of services provided;
  • content and quality of reports;
  • ability towards problem solving;
  • periodical demonstration of professional skills
  • continuous maintenance of the relationship with all stakeholders.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Advanced university degree in European affairs, public policy, law, economics, public administration, or other relevant field from an accredited academic institution.

Experience

  • Minimum of five years of progressively responsible professional experience in EU integration, public administration reform, policy coordination, migration governance, labour migration, diaspora engagement, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience in coordinating multidisciplinary teams, preparing analytical and policy-oriented documents, facilitating institutional consultations and working with government counterparts at senior technical level.

Skills

  • Strong analytical, drafting and policy coordination skills, with the ability to prepare clear, high-quality technical and briefing materials.
  • Sound understanding of EU integration processes, institutional coordination and public administration reform.
  • Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary experts, quality-assure technical inputs and support effective knowledge transfer to beneficiary institutions.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, organizational and communication skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with government counterparts, international organizations and technical experts.

Languages

For this consultancy, Full working proficiency in English and Albanian is required.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Notes

IOM covers Consultants against occupational accidents and illnesses under the Compensation Plan (CP), free of charge, for the duration of the consultancy. IOM does not provide evacuation or medical insurance for reasons related to non-occupational accidents and illnesses. Consultants are responsible for their own medical insurance for non-occupational accident or illness and will be required to provide written proof of such coverage before commencing work.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: CCTV Operator
description:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person



Position Overview:

YORK1 is seeking a reliable and safety-focused CCTV Operator to support sewer inspection and infrastructure projects across Ontario. The CCTV Operator is responsible for operating robotic CCTV inspection equipment to assess sewer lines, accurately documenting findings, and supporting project activities to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with industry standards.

The successful candidate will work both independently and as part of a field team and must be comfortable working in a variety of outdoor and job-site environments.


Licence/Certification:

  • NASSCO Certified Inspector (required)
  • Valid Class G Driver’s Licence (required)

Union Requirement: Successful candidates who are not currently members of the applicable union will be required to register with the union as a condition of employment in this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform robotic telemonitoring inspections of sewer lines in accordance with NASSCO standards.
  • Operate, monitor, and maintain robotic CCTV inspection equipment and related technology.
  • Conduct sewer inspections and accurately document and record inspection findings.
  • Identify and report defects, blockages, structural concerns, and other conditions observed during inspections.
  • Ensure CCTV inspection footage and project documentation are complete, accurate, and properly maintained.
  • Assist with sewer cleaning and other field activities as required to support project completion.
  • Conduct equipment checks and identify maintenance or operational issues.
  • Follow project-specific procedures, safety requirements, and applicable legislation and regulations.
  • Participate in required safety training, including OSHA-related training and courses.
  • Communicate professionally with team members, supervisors, clients, and members of the public.
  • Assist with public notification activities, including distributing project information and flyers to residents and businesses.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area and ensure equipment is properly secured and maintained.
  • Be prepared to stand, walk, kneel, bend, and work in various positions for extended periods.
  • Travel to project locations as required.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid Class G Driver’s Licence with a clean driving record.
  • NASSCO Certified Inspector designation required.
  • Previous experience operating and maintaining CCTV sewer inspection equipment.
  • Knowledge of sewer inspection processes and NASSCO standards.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document inspection findings.
  • Ability to interpret and record information displayed through CCTV inspection systems.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a field team.
  • Strong commitment to workplace health and safety.
  • Ability to work outdoors and in varying weather and site conditions.
  • Ability to perform the physical requirements of the role, including standing, walking, kneeling, bending, and working for extended periods.
  • Willingness to participate in required training and certifications.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • CCTV inspections completed accurately and in accordance with NASSCO standards.
  • Inspections and assigned project activities completed within established timelines.
  • Inspection footage, reports, coding, and project documentation completed accurately and on time.
  • CCTV equipment is properly operated, maintained, inspected, and reported on.
  • Consistent compliance with YORK1 and site-specific safety requirements with a strong focus on preventing incidents and injuries.
  • Effective cooperation with sewer cleaning crews and other field personnel to keep projects moving efficiently.
  • Consistent attendance, punctuality, and readiness for scheduled field assignments.
  • Professional and respectful communication with clients, residents, businesses, and members of the public.

Why This Role Matters at YORK1

CCTV Operators play an important role in helping YORK1 maintain and improve critical infrastructure across Ontario. Accurate sewer inspections provide project teams and clients with the information they need to understand the condition of underground infrastructure, identify issues, and make informed decisions about maintenance, rehabilitation, and repair.

Your work directly contributes to the safety, quality, and successful delivery of YORK1’s infrastructure and environmental projects.

At YORK1, we invest in our people through training, career development, and opportunities for growth. You will have the opportunity to build your technical expertise while working alongside experienced field and operations teams.

Why Work with YORK1?

Our employees play an important role in helping us achieve our mission of providing exceptional service and innovative solutions through our infrastructure and environmental services to some of the largest commercial and residential projects across Ontario. They are the foundation of our success and represent our greatest strength.

We focus on investing in our employees through career development programs, training, and internal opportunities and advancement. Right here and right now, we are building a culture of success that you can be a part of!

Apply Now!

We would like to thank everyone who applies; however, only those applicants who are most qualified will be contacted.

title: AI & Delivery Transformation Lead
description:
Your new company
Our client is a large organisation undergoing significant technology transformation. With an AI strategy already in place, the focus is now shifting from experimentation to execution, embedding AI into everyday delivery practices and empowering teams to work smarter, faster and more effectively.

Your new role
This is not your typical BA Practice Lead position.

  • Work closely with senior technology and AI leadership.
  • Play a key role in shaping the future of technology delivery.
  • A role combining strategic influence, hands-on transformation and people leadership.
If you're passionate about improving how technology is delivered and understand how AI can make a genuine difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Analyse complex business and technical requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications and user stories.
  • Conduct system impact assessments across applications, APIs, integrations, databases and data flows.
  • Develop current-state and future-state process models, solution designs and business rules.
  • Work closely with technical teams to define system functionality, interfaces and integration requirements.
  • Support the design and delivery of cloud-native applications within enterprise technology environments.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum delivery teams throughout discovery, design, development, testing and implementation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve technical challenges and ensure alignment between business needs and system capabilities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and team capability development.
Skills & Experience Required
  • Demonstrated experience as a Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or Business Systems Analyst within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of system integration, REST APIs, application interfaces and data flows.

description:
Reporting to the Supervisor, Home and Community Care, the Home and Community Care Worker II provides essential personal care and specialized support, including assistance with bathing, grooming, mobility, medication reminders, and individualized care for palliative, rehabilitation, post-acute clients.

The Home and Community Care Worker II exercises independent judgement in monitoring health status, identifying risks, and determining when to escalate concerns to health professionals, often in unpredictable and isolated environments where immediate clinical support is not available. These decisions directly affect client safety, well-being, and continuity of care, reducing preventable hospital admissions and alleviating pressure on acute care facilities.

The role carries accountability for maintaining strict confidentiality, adhering to health and safety protocols, and advocating for client needs through a cultural lens to ensure client care plans respect Inuit values and traditions. Through these responsibilities, the position plays a vital role in sustaining community health and advancing Government of Nunavut’s commitment to equitable and culturally safe health services.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, problem-solving and judgement in identifying health risks and determining appropriate actions are required for this position. Also, the ability to interpret and convey health-related information accurately, work independently in unpredictable home environments under indirect supervision and physical ability to assist with transfers, mobility, and household tasks are also required.

The knowledge, skills, and abilities required for this job are typically acquired through completion of Grade 12 and two years of home care experience, or equivalent life experience providing personal care for family or community members, including Elders or individuals with health challenges.

BCLS (Basic Cardiac Life Support), First Aid Certificates, Training in personal care skills or home support and basic computer skills for documentation are assets.

This is a Highly Sensitive Position and a satisfactory Criminal Record Check, along with a clear Vulnerable Sector Check is required.

The Official Languages of Nunavut are Inuktut, English and French. Applicants may submit their resume in any of the official languages of Nunavut. Fluency in more than one of Nunavut’s official languages would be considered an asset. Knowledge of Inuit communities, culture, land,Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit, Inuktut and experience working in a northern cross-cultural environment are also considered assets.

Acceptable combinations of education and experience may be considered for this position. We encourage you to apply if you have equivalent years of education and/or experience equal to the education and experience requirements listed above.

This is only a requirement for positions that require a satisfactory criminal record or vulnerable sector check.
  • Applicants may submit their resume in any of the Official Languages of Nunavut.

title: Senior Program Manager I - Laser Communications
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we’re building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, laser communication terminals, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER I - LASER COMMUNICATIONS

Laser communication is the backbone of the constellations of today and tomorrow, and demand for it is growing fast. We are scaling industry-leading optical communication terminals to meet it: high-performing, affordable, and available at the volume commercial and government constellation operators need. Based at Rocket Lab’s global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, you are the customer’s champion and the delivery lead for our optical communication terminal programs. You own the customer outcome: the day-to-day relationship, delivery commitments and schedule at rate, milestone and acceptance reviews, risk, and program health. You build on a proven, standard terminal product and partner closely with our Product team on configuration, pricing, and new customer needs. You’ll work alongside the teams that build the spacecraft, the components, and the rockets, so the people you need to solve a problem are down the hall, not under another contract. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role: you connect the customer, our engineering teams, the production line, and the business across two continents, and you’re the person our customers count on.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Lead Delivery: Lead terminal programs from award through qualification, production at rate, delivery, and on-orbit checkout, across current-generation production and next-generation variants. Hold each program to its plan and deliver on schedule, technical performance, and every customer commitment.
  • Lead the Team of Teams: Run multiple concurrent customer programs, work closely with Chief Engineers on link performance, data rate, SWaP, environmental qualification, and optical terminal interoperability, and dive in personally on the problems that matter most to delivery.
  • Deliver at Rate: Own each program’s delivery profile and protect it. Spot yield, supplier, and test-capacity risk early and drive it to closure with Operations and the Product team.
  • Forge the Supply Chain: Partner with Supply Chain to manage critical suppliers as strategic partners, building the relationships and accountability that keep every customer delivery on schedule.
  • Run the Program Lifecycle: Own program startup and baselining, milestone and qualification reviews, export and ITAR obligations with Trade Compliance, customer acceptance, and closeout across our U.S. and European sites.
  • Champion the Customer: Be the trusted point of contact for customers through milestone reviews, interoperability campaigns, acceptance, and delivery. Partner with BD & Strategy on proposals and with the Product team on pricing and configuration, bringing the voice of the customer to every decision.
  • Raise the Bar: Mentor the people around you, set a high standard for how we show up for customers, and help develop the program leaders who will run our next generation of laser communications programs.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER I:

  • Engineering Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or Math.
  • Technical Depth: Working understanding of free-space optical or RF communications: link budgets, pointing, acquisition, and tracking, modems and coding, and space or airborne environmental qualification.
  • 5+ years in space, aerospace, or photonics hardware programs, with multiple full program cycles. We weight the hardest thing you’ve shipped over the count.
  • Customer Delivery: A track record of leading a complex hardware program to delivery (customer, schedule, risk, and acceptance) and carrying it across the finish line under real pressure.
  • Production Delivery: Evidence you’ve moved real hardware from prototype to qualified, rate-production delivery to customers.
  • Program Financials: Experience managing program cost, EAC, and customer contract changes in partnership with finance and product teams on a program of meaningful scale.
  • Proof Point: You’ve delivered hardware at rate to a demanding customer and kept their trust through a hard moment, such as a slip, a test failure, or a contract change.
  • Clearance: U.S. Person status required (ITAR/EAR); ability to obtain a security clearance preferred.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Domain Authority: Direct experience with optical inter-satellite links or optical ground or airborne terminals.
  • Production Velocity: A proven playbook for taking low-volume, hand-built optical or electro-optical hardware into high-rate production without sacrificing reliability.
  • Constellation Fluency: Experience delivering to large commercial or defense constellation programs.
  • Customer Leadership: Experience as the primary customer interface for constellation operators or satellite primes, from kickoff through acceptance.
  • Global Leadership: Experience leading program work across geographically dispersed sites, including export-control and dual-use compliance.
  • Advanced Technical Credibility: A Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Optics/Photonics, Physics, or a related field.
  • Systems & Toolchain Fluency: You speak systems engineering (trade studies, interface control, requirement integrity) and use Jira, Confluence, and ERP/MRP to keep program health visible at speed.
  • AI Fluency: You put AI tools to work in day-to-day program management, from schedule and risk analysis to status reporting and customer communications, so you and your team spend more time on the problems that matter.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)
$137,075—$196,275 USD
Base Salary
$116,800—$160,600 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

title: Lifestyle Team Leader
description:
Overview

About Us

At Palm Lake Care, care isn’t just what we do – it’s who we are. As a proud, family-owned organisation, we’ve built our reputation on values that put people first. Across our seven premium aged care communities, we provide personalised residential, respite, and palliative care in vibrant, welcoming environments where every resident feels truly valued.

Our team is united by a simple promise: I will make a difference for you, right now. That belief drives us to go the extra mile, knowing the little things often matter most. Here, respect is at the heart of every interaction – with residents, families, and each other because we believe that how we treat people conveys everything about us as a company and you as an individual.

Our Palm Lake Promise to you is that here, you will make a difference.

Position Details

Palm Lake Care Beachmere is seeking a Lifestyle Team Leader to join our team on a Full Time permanent basis, working 38 hours per week. Reporting to the Clinical Manager, you'll take the lead in planning and delivering an engaging lifestyle program that enriches the lives of our residents. You'll guide a team of Lifestyle Assistants, helping them create moments that matter through social, recreational, and wellness-based activities. You'll also be a key connector with the broader community - coordinating entertainment, liaising with volunteers, and building strong ties with groups such as schools, religious leaders, and service clubs.

If you're ready to lead with empathy and create meaningful experiences for our residents, this could be the perfect role for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Greeting residents and informing them about the day's activities

  • Welcoming new residents and completing their social profiles and activity plans

  • Creating monthly calendars and newsletters

  • Organising community events and external outings

  • Supporting staff development and participating in continuous improvement initiatives

What We're Looking For:

To thrive in this role, you will need:

  • Certificate IV in Leisure and Health

  • Demonstrated experience in diversional therapy or lifestyle programming

  • 1-2 years experience in a Team Leader or Supervisory role
  • A current National Police Check

  • A current “C” class driver’s license and confidence in transporting residents

  • Strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate a small team

  • Enthusiasm and creativity to enrich the lives of our residents
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to effectively work with a range of internal & external stakeholders
  • A compassionate approach and empathy for older people and their families
  • A high level of self-motivation, initiative and the ability to work without supervision

You'll Stand out if you have:

  • Knowledge of Autumn Care (highly regarded but not essential
  • Knowledge of the Aged Care Quality standards
  • Demonstrated understanding of AN-ACC framework

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Rates - including weekend and overtime penalties
  • Work-life Balance with a variety of shifts available
  • Training & Development – Ongoing on-the-job training and online training specifically designed to support you in your role and prepare you for professional growth opportunities
  • 24/7 free access to compassionate, confidential support with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Celebrate Milestones with tenure rewards!
  • Palm Lake Care Perks – We offer a selection of complimentary beverages, treats, fruits and bites for staff to enjoy
  • Supportive team culture – Be part of a vibrant and inclusive community where your contributions are valued
  • Career Opportunities - Palm Lake Group spans 4 entities, 27 lifestyle resort communities and 7 aged care facilities across Australia's east coast, from development & construction to resort management & aged care, the career pathways and opportunities with Palm Lake Group are truly endless.

Join a Team That Cares!

We believe belonging and connection are fundamental rights of ageing. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in the lives of others and want to work in a supportive and rewarding environment, we’d love to hear from you!

As an inclusive and culturally sensitive workplace, we invite individuals from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds, as well as from all walks of life, to apply for this role.

Apply now and become part of a team that truly cares.

All applicants must provide a valid national police check and undergo a pre-employment medical assessment.

Please note, all Palm Lake Care Communities are smoke-free workplaces.

title: 23193 - Case Administrator - Poole (South West)
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

The post is currently advertised without VISOR Vetting to enable appointment to take place as soon as possible, however, VISOR vetting will be required to be completed post offer.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Cloud engineer mid (hybrid)
description:
CLOUD ENGINEER MID (HYBRID PORTO)

Portuguese company hires for hybrid position

Location: Porto, Portugal

⚠️ Only candidates already based in Portugal will be considered

Work Model: Hybrid — 2 days per week in the office

️ Language Requirements: Fluent English required

Seniority: Mid-level (3+ years)

Rate Between €2200 - 2500 RV or unipessoal (gross value)

⚠️ Instructions: Please send your CV in English and make sure to include all skills and experience that match the requirements of the opportunity. This will significantly increase your chances of success.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to develop cloud-native infrastructure and improve platform reliability through automation and Infrastructure as Code. You will work closely with development teams to support resilient and observable applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code.
  • Build scripts, services, and pipelines to improve reliability and developer experience.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure applications are cloud-ready, observable, and resilient.
  • Troubleshoot platform issues and support incident resolution and root-cause analysis.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Programming skills in Java or Python for automation, plus knowledge of Go (Golang).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Ansible. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, ARM, or Pulumi are also accepted.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including knowledge of Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs).
  • Strong understanding of Linux, networking, distributed systems, SRE principles, and production operations.
  • Familiarity with Envoy and hands-on experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Splunk.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, and Agile environments using Scrum or Kanban.

Preferred: Foundational or Associate-level certifications in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A proactive, analytical engineer who works autonomously, communicates openly, and collaborates effectively with technical and business teams. A structured approach to troubleshooting and an interest in continuous learning are important.

5 Questions for Candidates

  1. Do you have 3+ years of relevant experience, and which cloud platforms have you used?
  2. What infrastructure or workflows have you automated using IaC and Java or Python?
  3. What experience do you have with Kubernetes, CRDs, and Envoy?
  4. How have you used observability tools and CI/CD pipelines to improve platform reliability?
  5. Are you fluent in English and available to work on-site in Porto 2 days per week?

Keywords

Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Ansible, IaC, Java, Python, Golang, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CRDs, Envoy, SRE, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, CI/CD, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.

title: Software Engineer / Full Stack Engineer (All Levels, Several Positions)
description:
Salary: $70,000 to $130,000 plus super

PREFERRED WAY TO APPLY: the Careers page on the Stanford website (https://stanford.au/careers).

It includes a short skills screen. Applications through SEEK are also accepted.

About Stanford

Stanford exists to guide Australians through life's biggest moments.

We do this by building the best in-house technology to amplify the best human talent in their mission to deliver outstanding experiences and results for their clients in Professional Services.

Stanford Innovations is the team that builds it. We are developing an AI-powered operating system for professional services: an end-to-end, walled garden platform that changes how people interact with these industries in Australia. Built in-house. Owned entirely by us. The new SaaS is Service as a Software.

Stanford Innovations Pty Ltd and Stanford Legal Pty Ltd are companies in the Stanford group. These positions sit in Stanford Innovations.

We're a team of high performers. We work hard, we deliver, and we know when to step away. The standard is high, and so is the support.

About the Roles

We're hiring several Software Engineers, from junior through to lead level, to join the team building the platform that disrupts professional services from within.

You're not patching legacy systems or shipping features for a client who changes their mind every week. You're building an intelligent, integrated platform inside one of Australia's fastest-growing professional services groups, on top of 12 months of strong technical foundations already laid.

You'll work across React frontends, PHP and Node backends, Python tooling, and TypeScript throughout. You'll touch AWS, GCP, and Azure. You'll design databases, solve hard problems, and keep security front of mind.

This team moves fast. But fast without reliability isn't fast, it's debt. You'll know the difference.

AI is central to how we build. Tools like Claude Code and Cursor aren't novelties here. They're how serious engineers accelerate.

What You'll Do

  • Work out what the business and its users need from a system, and turn that into designs and technical specifications

  • Write and maintain code to those specifications and to our quality standards

  • Test, debug, diagnose and fix faults inside our testing protocols, so what ships performs to specification

  • Find the limits and weak points in existing systems and the processes around them, and fix them

  • Write and maintain technical documentation, user guides and operating procedures

  • Build and run automated testing and deployment

  • Collect and read operational metrics, and use them to make the platform faster and more reliable

  • Spot and reduce risks to performance and security across the life of the product

At Senior and Lead Level You'll Also

  • Own the architecture and technical direction of major parts of the platform

  • Advise the directors on software strategy, including build or buy decisions and the costing of software purchases and upgrades

  • Set the continuous improvement and continuous delivery practices the team works to

  • Build the internal tools that support the software, its management and its security

  • Set engineering standards, review code and mentor other engineers

  • Lead projects end to end, from requirements through to production

What We're Looking For

  • Strong full stack experience across React, PHP, JavaScript, Node, TypeScript, and Python

  • Database design and optimisation across SQL and NoSQL

  • Comfortable operating across cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • A track record of solving hard problems and shipping reliable software under pressure

  • You produce clean, thoughtful code and you care about the engineer who comes after you

  • You use AI tools actively and know how to get real leverage out of them

  • A degree in software engineering, computer science or a related field, or experience that shows the same ability

  • For senior and lead positions: you have owned a production platform end to end, led other engineers, and made architecture decisions you then had to live with

Remuneration

Engineer (junior to mid-level): $70,000 to $110,000 plus super.

Senior and Lead: $110,000 to $130,000 plus super.

Where you sit depends on your experience and capability.

Ready to Help Change Lives?

If you want to build technology that genuinely disrupts how professional services are delivered in Australia, and you want to do it from the inside with a team that executes, we'd love to meet you.

Apply now for a confidential discussion.

In your application, include:

  • The level you are applying for.

  • A brief example of a technically complex problem you solved and how you approached it.

  • The AI tools you use in your development workflow and how they actually change the way you work (so we know you've read this far).

title: 30311 - Armed Security Officer Fri-Sun 4pm-12am
description:

title: Service Systems Administrator
description:
We at Acxelsus ﻿are on a mission to showcase exceptional Filipino talent globally. Beyond educational credentials and professional experience, we highly prioritize passion, dedication, loyalty, and a proactive attitude towards personal growth.

Our foundation is built upon a set of core values - R.I.G.H.T. - representing Reliability, Integrity, Goal-Oriented mindset, Happiness, and Teamwork. These values define our identity and guide our approach to achieving success.

Job Overview

The Service Systems Administrator will manage the setup and day-to-day administration of the client's service management platform. The role involves configuring the system based on the business's existing processes, testing workflows, training the team, and making sure the platform continues to work smoothly after implementation. The ideal candidate is someone who understands service-based operations and can set up and maintain a system that is practical, straightforward, and easy for the team to use. Provide additional marketing support as needed.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Setup & Implementation

  • Platform Configuration: Configure the client's service management platform (CRM, field service, or similar) to match their real workflow — job intake, scheduling, service records, quoting, and invoicing.
  • Data & Catalog Setup: Load only the products, parts, and data the client actually uses, keeping lists, dropdowns, and fields short and relevant.
  • Process Mapping: Translate the service team's real-world processes into system configuration, working from process maps and input provided by the team.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Test every workflow end-to-end and resolve issues before the service team begins user acceptance testing.
  • Vendor Coordination: Liaise with the platform vendor's support team on setup questions, issues, and updates.
  • Integrations: Set up and maintain system integrations, starting with Xero for invoicing.

Ongoing Platform Support & Admin

  • Platform Ownership: Act as the platform's owner and go-to expert following rollout.
  • AI & Workflow Automation: Help identify and implement AI agents and automation tools to reduce manual workload across the team.
  • Reporting: Generate service reports and dashboards for management.
  • Invoicing: Create invoices within the platform so they flow to Xero for approval and sending.
  • Data Maintenance: Keep platform data clean — removing discontinued products, resolving duplicate records, and updating pricing.
  • Continuous Improvement: Roll out new features, upgrades, and integrations as the business's needs evolve.
  • Customer Support Coverage: Handle basic inbound customer calls and emails when the service team needs backup.

Training & Marketing Support

  • Training Delivery: Run training sessions for the service team during the initial rollout (weekly at first) and onboard new staff onto the platform.
  • Training Materials: Create training materials — short walkthrough videos, slide decks, and quick-reference guides — alongside written how-to guides and process notes.
  • Additional Marketing Support: Assist with LinkedIn content creation, basic graphics and short videos, sales presentations, website updates, and email campaigns as needed, alongside the primary platform implementation and support responsibilities.

Qualifications

  • Education: A degree or background in Engineering is preferred, particularly in mechanical, HVAC, industrial, or related technical fields. The client is willing to train the right candidate in their business and service processes.
  • Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience configuring or administering CRM, field service, ERP/inventory, or business management platforms such as ServiceM8, Jobber, Zoho, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Odoo, Ascora, Fergus, WorkGuru, Tradify, or similar, including training users on new software. Xero or other accounting system integration experience is a strong plus.
  • Functional Skills: Strong understanding of service business workflows, with the ability to translate business processes into practical system configurations and solve workflow issues. Hands-on and self-directed — comfortable picking up new tools independently and taking on tasks outside a narrow job description as the role evolves.
  • Technical Skills: Experience with system integrations, data management, reporting, testing, and user training, plus hands-on exposure to AI tools and workflow automation (e.g., ChatGPT, Zapier, Make, n8n). Xero or other accounting system integration experience is a plus.
  • Marketing Skills: Experience managing LinkedIn or company social media, with skills in Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools and basic video editing.
  • Language: Clear written and spoken English, with confidence communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

What We Offer

Here at Acxelsus, our people come first. We offer total compensation to ensure our team experiences overall wellness and has the financial resources and support they need.

  • Market-competitive salary
  • Health & group life Insurance
  • Fixed weekends off; Dayshift schedule
  • Paid time off and birthday leave
  • Learning & development
  • Employee recognition
  • Work-life balance
  • Diverse and positive work environment

Ready to experience the #AcxelsusAdvantage? Join our team today!

title: Composite Associate 1 - Intermediate
description:
Job Summary:

This position will perform fabrication of Arrowhead Products composite/non-metal components & products. It is a combination of the following jobs: Parts Identifier, Assembler.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Will utilize blueprints and production planning instructions to perform marking, identification, trimming, cutting, drilling, and assembly of composite/non-metal parts.
  • Must be able to perform identification operations on all product lines, assemblies, and sub-assemblies; follow specifications and procedures pertaining to identification; read blueprints.
  • Must be accurate with the use of numbers.
  • Familiar with Microsoft Windows, Word, Excel, and able to perform data entry.
  • Must be able to perform manual identification using stencils and rubber stamps, including stencil identification on metal tags in accordance with drawing specifications.
  • Must be able to utilize the video jet identification machine and perform cleaning operations.
  • Perform operations such as curing and trimming insulation materials, applying plastic impregnated fiberglass fabric and metal to semi-finished blankets, cutting materials to pattern, hand lay-up, and wrapping insulation blankets onto ducting.
  • Develop patterns for layup to produce parts to specific drawing requirements.
  • Operate curing ovens, hand/power tools, and other machinery related to composite fabrication.
  • Will work with materials such as coated fabrics, rubber, adhesives, cements, plastics, and other materials related to composite fabrication.
  • Will make void-free laminates and perform acceptable repairs to parts per blueprint specifications or planning requirements.
  • Will make and perform tool setups as needed.
  • Will perform material use calculation and accurate tracking for inventory record keeping.
  • Will perform auxiliary operations such as handling/moving parts, tooling and materials, tool stripping, spray painting, and secondary wrapping operations.
  • Responsible for assisting the department in the development of techniques to increase productivity, quality, and throughput of products and to share job knowledge in the department.
  • Record all traceability information of material used and log on shop travelers.
  • Will maintain work area and equipment in a clean, orderly, FOD-free fashion and adhere to all Safety standards.
  • This job description is not all inclusive of all duties. Other job duties consistent with the Composite Associate 1 position may be assigned.

Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous Composites fabrication experience preferred and may be substituted for education requirement.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to perform quality work in a safe and efficient manner.
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, work orders, and production planning documents.
  • Ability to use standard manufacturing measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, tape measures, and scales.
  • Must be capable of working with tight tolerances such as + or - .001”.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • N/A

Physical Demands:

To successfully perform the essential functions of this role, an individual must:

  • Work Environment Exposures:
    • Work around equipment and machinery in a manufacturing environment.
    • Walk on uneven ground.
    • Be exposed to excessive noise, dust, gases, fumes, and chemicals commonly associated with manufacturing processes (e.g., paint, solvents, coatings, and fiberglass).
    • Be exposed to extremes in temperature, humidity, or wetness, particularly on the manufacturing floor.
  • Protective Equipment:
    • Use special visual or auditory protective equipment as required.
    • Use safety glasses and wear safety shoes as required.
    • Be able to be medically cleared for a respirator at the occupational clinic and pass a fit test for full and/or half face respirator. Additionally, must shave off facial hair (be clean -shaven) when using a respirator
    • Must use Tyvek suit and full-face respirator.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequent lifting of up to 35 lbs.
  • Frequent pushing and pulling.
  • Bend, stoop, and squat occasionally.
  • Sit, stand, and walk frequently.
  • Talk and listen frequently.
  • Occasional use of computers.
  • Constant use and motion of hands and arms, including squeezing, gripping, and pinching.
  • Constant exposure to manufacturing shop noise.

Special Requirements:

  • N/A

Limitations and Disclaimer:

This job description outlines essential responsibilities but does not represent an exhaustive list. The company provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with ADA and applicable state laws.

title: Senior Engineer (Civil)
description:
SENIOR ENGINEER (CIVIL) — Hong Kong

Confidential Client | Multiple Vacancies | Permanent

REF: 3CRGH-SECV-1026 | Strictly confidential — client identity disclosed to shortlisted candidates only

About 3cRGH (Your consultant on this search)

3cRGH is a specialist construction & infrastructure recruitment firm covering APAC, and part of RGH Global — a UK-headquartered People Services and Workforce Optimisation group. We work the engineering market at desk level: we know the projects, the teams, and what a career move is actually worth. One of Hong Kong's tier-one main contractors, with decades of landmark delivery across the territory and a current civil order book that is arguably the deepest in the market. The group is a recognised pioneer of MiC (Modular Integrated Construction) and smart-site technologies, holds a leading position in the Northern Metropolis programme, and carries an award-winning safety and environmental record.

The civil portfolio you would join (live projects, described in confidence)

You will be placed into one or more of the following active civil engineering projects — at offer stage we disclose exact assignments:

  • Water & wastewater mega-projects — large-scale sewage and wastewater treatment infrastructure in the New Territories, including treatment plant civil works and one of Hong Kong's most complex underground construction programmes
  • Flood protection & river works — major flood barrier, pumping station and river channel works in the western New Territories, delivered under modern collaborative NEC contracting
  • Highways & strategic roads — strategic trunk road widening, new interchanges and associated infrastructure within a flagship northern new development area
  • Railway civil engineering — new railway station and trackwork civils on a live MTR corridor, delivered under target-cost NEC partnering contracts

The role — Senior Engineer (Civil)

Working within the contractor's civil engineering division, under the direction of the Project Manager / Agent, you will take ownership of day-to-day engineering delivery on large-scale civil works:

  • Plan, direct and supervise civil works on site, ensuring compliance with drawings, specifications, method statements and ITPs
  • Coordinate with site agents, foremen, subcontractors, consultants and client representatives
  • Review temporary works, construction methodology and technical submissions
  • Drive programme adherence in conjunction with the planning team; flag and resolve critical-path risks early
  • Control quality, safety and environmental standards on your work fronts
  • Support the Project Engineer / APM in cost, variation and progress reporting
  • Mentor graduate and site engineers

Requirements

  • Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent discipline
  • Minimum 6 years' site experience on large-scale civil engineering projects, main contractor side

  • Professional membership (e.g. MHKIE / CEng MICE) preferred — chartership recognised with a salary premium
  • Strong written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese and/or Putonghua)
  • Hands-on with site documentation: method statements, ITPs, RFIs, progress records
  • Ambition for APM track is a genuine advantage — this contractor promotes from within across a 70+ project Hong Kong portfolio

The package

  • Base salary at a competitive market rate for a chartered senior engineer at a tier-one contractor
  • Double pay + discretionary performance bonus
  • Site allowance, medical benefits, and structured professional development (including HKIE Scheme A support where applicable)
  • A visible runway: Senior Engineer Assistant Project Manager Project Manager, on a pipeline measured in decades, not years

﻿All applications and enquiries are treated in absolute confidence. Client identity is disclosed only to candidates who pass our initial consultation and are shortlisted for client interview.﻿

title: Technical Consultant
description:
The Technical Consultant is a client-facing technical advisor who helps translate business needs into reliable MHK solutions. The hybrid-based role investigates root causes across data, integrations, configuration, and system behavior; supports implementation and validation; and guides solution decisions. By coordinating with clients and internal teams, the consultant helps resolve complex issues and deliver sustainable outcomes.

  • Use SQL, system data, logs, configuration, and approved tools to investigate issues, validate behavior, and identify likely causes across configuration, data, integrations, environments, workflows, or product functionality.

  • Triage complex escalations by assessing scope, impact, reproducibility, and priority; gather evidence, recommend next steps, and provide context before routing issues to Product or Software Engineering.

  • Support client file layouts, inbound and outbound feeds, batch processing, SFTP operations, PBM exchanges, vendor feeds, and related integration workflows.

  • Analyze files, payloads, rejections, mappings, code values, crosswalks, and processing results; partner with clients, PBMs, vendors, and internal teams to resolve issues, identify corrective actions, and document assumptions, dependencies, and repeatable solutions.

  • Build trusted client relationships and provide guidance that supports successful outcomes; recommend and validate solution options, identify appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and partner with Sales and Account Management on client growth and retention.

  • Partner with Functional Consultants to clarify client needs, support configuration, and contribute to implementations, enhancements, and client-specific operational delivery.

  • Validate configuration, environment readiness, setup, workflow feasibility, and technical outcomes against requirements; identify and communicate risks, gaps, blockers, and dependencies.

  • Advise clients on configuration implications, product behavior, best practices, solution options, and operational trade-offs, translating technical findings into clear business guidance.

  • Develop or support risk-based validation for defects, enhancements, configuration changes, client issues, and release activity; coordinate with QA when formal testing is needed.

  • Confirm changes meet requirements, achieve expected outcomes, and avoid unnecessary downstream impact. Document expected and actual results and unresolved risks in a concise, reusable format.

  • Support release, regression, upgrade, and production validation across applicable environments.

  • Identify opportunities to expand or optimize services and partner with Sales and Account Management to support appropriate cross-sell or upsell discussions, client growth, adoption, and retention.

  • Effectively use approved AI technologies to enhance productivity, automate routine technical tasks, improve the quality of analysis and documentation, and support faster client issue resolution, while maintaining compliance with MHK security, privacy, HIPAA/PHI, and responsible AI policies.

  • Five (5) years of experience in technical consulting, application support, implementation, systems analysis, integration operations, or a similar client-facing technical role.

  • Working proficiency with SQL and data analysis concepts to investigate data integrity, validate system behavior, and explain data-driven findings.

  • Practical experience with Linux/Unix shell commands and structured data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON, or fixed-width files.

  • Hands-on experience testing and validating REST or SOAP APIs with tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or cURL.

  • Hands-on experience with secure file transfer processes, including SFTP or FTPS and PGP/GPG encryption, decryption, or validation.

  • Working knowledge of system configuration, integrations, technical support processes, testing, and environment validation.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to move from symptoms to root cause and explain technical topics to business, operational, and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in healthcare technology, payer operations, care management, utilization management, appeals and grievances, or another regulated environment.

  • Experience with enterprise schedulers or batch workflow tools, operational and BI data environments, Python or shell scripting, and Git or Bitbucket.

  • Exposure to modern AI platforms and developer tools, including LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or similar), with an interest in applying generative AI to technical consulting, automation, and problem solving.

  • Enterprise schedulers such as Skybot/Automate Schedule, Cron, Control-M, or Autosys.

  • Understanding of enterprise batch operations, concurrent processing, analytics platforms, and data reconciliation techniques used to support operational reporting and system monitoring.

  • Python or shell scripting for automation, validation, troubleshooting, or operational support.

Education/Certification Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent practical experience, and at least three years of experience in technical consulting, application support, implementation, systems analysis, integration operations, or a related client-facing technical role.

At MHK we help health plans and pharmacy benefit managers deliver optimal care management across every member’s health journey. We do this through state-of-the-art technology that provides critical insights from member enrollment and maintenance through every stage of care and compliance. We believe that long-term partnerships are built on trust. Our team members are expected to build trusted advisory relationships - with MHK clients and one another - through responsive, transparent communication, while honoring commitments, and tying that trust to outcomes.
